jobs.title: Clinical Oncology Genomics APP (contract)
jobs.description:
Reimagine the infrastructure of cancer care within a community that values integrity, inspires growth, and is uniquely positioned to create a more modern, connected oncology ecosystem. We’re looking for an advanced practice provider to help us accomplish our mission to improve and extend lives by learning from the experience of every person with cancer. Are you ready to be the next changemaker in cancer care?

What You'll Do

As an Advanced Practice Provider (APP) on the Clinical Oncology Team, you will use your deep expertise in oncology and genomics to inform the design, development, and optimization of Flatiron Health’s point of care products, tools, and service.

The Clinical Oncology Genomics APP will play a critical role as a subject matter expert at the intersection of clinical practice and precision medicine. The role is designed for an advanced practice provider (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) with deep experience in clinical oncology, genomic testing, somatic and germline test result interpretation, and subsequent patient care and clinical decisions.

Over the term of the contract you will serve as:

Clinical-Genomics Product Expert

• Serve as the subject matter expert at the intersection of clinical oncology and genomics for Flatiron’s product development teams.

• Interpret complex genomic test results and translate clinical workflows into actionable product requirements.

• Advise on the integration of molecular diagnostics and precision medicine into Flatiron’s software solutions, ensuring products reflect real-world clinical needs and best practices.

• Review and validate product features related to genomic data capture, interpretation, and clinical decision support.

• Assess the quality of product output to ensure clinical validity and accuracy prior to these features being in the hands of our point of care customers.

Product & Workflow Enhancement

• Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Clinical teams to inform and test enhancements to clinical workflows in OncoEMR and other Flatiron products.

• Represent the voice of providers in product discovery, scoping, development, rollout, and maintenance phases.

Education & Enablement

• Develop and deliver educational resources (e.g., guides, presentations, webinars) to help practices utilize point of care genomic testing recommendations, orders, and results in support of personalized patient care.

• Serve as a resource for Flatiron colleagues, providing clear explanations of genomic concepts and their impact on product design, user experience, and patient impact.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with internal stakeholders to ensure alignment between clinical workflows, product features, and business objectives.

• Participate in multidisciplinary discussions focused on the clinical implications of genomics in oncology care.

• Stay current on advances in molecular diagnostics, targeted therapies, and precision medicine guidelines to inform ongoing product innovation.

Who You Are

You're a kind, passionate and collaborative problem-solver who values the opportunity to think beyond the way things are.

• You are an experienced Advanced Practice Provider (NP or PA) with at least 5 years of oncology experience in a community or academic setting.

• You have demonstrated expertise in interpreting somatic genomic test results (e.g., NGS panels) and understand how these results inform treatment decisions and have taken action on them in a clinical setting for patients.

• You possess a deep understanding of the clinical-genomics landscape, including familiarity with NCCN Guidelines, molecular diagnostics, and precision medicine workflows.

• You are an excellent communicator who can distill complex genomic concepts for diverse audiences—product managers, engineers, designers, and other non-clinical stakeholders.

• You are passionate about education and have experience developing or delivering training on clinical-genomics topics.

• You are collaborative, resourceful, and thrive in a fast-paced environment focused on improving cancer care through technology.

• You are available for intermittent travel in support of practice engagements and go lives.

• You are available for a 6-month contract engagement with flexibility to ramp up quickly and deliver impact in a defined timeframe.

Extra credit

• Experience with OncoEMR or similar oncology EHRs; experience with Flatiron Assist is a plus.

• Prior involvement in clinical research or quality improvement initiatives related to precision medicine.

• Certification or advanced training in genomics or precision medicine.

• Prior contract or consulting experience in healthcare technology or product development.

Where you’ll work

In this remote position, you have the freedom to choose your preferred work location while aligning your working hours with your team's. For further details on our hybrid work approach and remote work type, please visit the how we work website.

Life at Flatiron

At Flatiron Health, we offer a full range of benefits to support you and your loved ones so you can focus your working hours on improving cancer care and accelerating cancer research, and your non-working hours on everything else life has to offer:

• Work/life autonomy via flexible work hours and flexible paid time off

• Comprehensive compensation package

• 401(k) contribution to help you reach your retirement planning goals*

• Financial health resources including 1:1 financial advice

• Mental well-being tools and services

• Parental benefits and policies including family-building care and generous leave

• Path to parenthood programs supporting fertility, adoption, and surrogacy

• Travel support for safe healthcare services

*Note: Eligibility for certain benefits may vary for contract employees. Please inquire about specific benefit availability for your contract role.

In addition to our robust benefit offerings, visit our Life at Flatiron page to learn how we support continuous learning and celebrate inclusion and belonging in the workplace.

jobs.title: Manager - Family Intake and Enrollment
jobs.description:
MeBe is a provider of evidence-based therapies for children with autism and other special needs. Our mission is to empower families, professionals, and communities by educating and training them on evidence-based approaches. Our secret sauce? Play-filled, research-based care across multi-disciplines including ABA, Speech and OT.



At MeBe, you’ll be offered more than a job. You’ll receive training and support to develop your career and grow as an individual. You’ll work with extraordinary team members who share a common goal—to help children with autism be their best selves. Your days will be filled with meaning and purpose.



MeBe is seeking a Manager – Family Intake & Enrollment to lead the first chapter of a family’s experience with us. You’ll lead the Family Success Liaison team and own the family journey from initial inquiry through service start—including family discovery, outreach quality, team performance, technology, workflows, and lead-to-enrollment results.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who thrives on building structure, developing people, using data to improve performance, and creating an exceptional experience during what can be an emotional and complex decision-making process for families. Success means building a predictable, high-quality path to enrollment while ensuring families feel informed, supported, and confident at every step.

 

Responsibilities:

 - Family Discovery: Ensure families receive a comprehensive, whole-child discovery experience that explores developmental, communication, sensory, social, behavioral, and educational needs and helps them understand the full range of MeBe services that may benefit their child.

 - Family Access Operations: Ensure families move smoothly through insurance verification, benefits education, and funding workflows, with accurate guidance on coverage, accepted payers, service availability, and alternatives when coverage limitations exist.

 - Systems & Technology Ownership: Demonstrated success hands-on managing and optimizing CRM and customer communication systems—ideally Zoho CRM, Zoho Bookings, RingCentral, or comparable platforms—including workflow configuration, automation, data quality, reporting, troubleshooting, and team adoption.

 - Quality Systems & Controls: Establish and continuously improve the standards, templates, workflows, quality controls, and reporting that create clear guardrails for FSL execution. Monitor CRM hygiene, response times, outreach cadence, documentation, appointment progression, and journey-stage movement to identify breakdowns and drive consistent quality.

 - FSL Team Leadership & Performance: Hire, train, coach, and performance-manage the FSL team. Routinely review calls, emails, texts, CRM activity, and family progression to identify performance gaps, provide timely feedback, and ensure consistent execution against established standards.

 - Lead-to-Enrollment Performance: Own performance and reporting across the lead-to-enrollment funnel, including response time, contact rates, discovery calls, site tours, assessment conversion, authorization progression, service starts, lead aging, and journey-stage drop-off. Use data to identify barriers, improve conversion, and hold the team accountable for timely follow-through.

 - Clinical Capacity & Site Partnership: Partner with Site Directors and Operations to align family intake and enrollment with clinical capacity, service availability, and site-specific growth goals.

 - Referral Partner Collaboration: Partner with Business Development to strengthen referral relationships and ensure FSLs provide responsive, professional communication with referring providers regarding family status, service availability, and referral outcomes. Use insights from family and referral interactions to identify opportunities to improve the referral experience and support long-term partnerships.

 
 

Qualifications and Skills:

 - Team Leadership & Development: Demonstrated success leading and developing a client-facing team, including hiring, training, quality monitoring, coaching, accountability, and performance management.

 - Enrollment & Pipeline Performance: Proven ownership of intake-to-enrollment performance, including pipeline management, follow-up execution, reducing drop-off, and achieving measurable enrollment outcomes.

 - Systems & Technology Ownership: Demonstrated success owning CRM and customer communication systems—ideally Zoho CRM, Zoho Bookings, RingCentral, or comparable platforms—including workflow configuration, automation, data quality, reporting, and team adoption.

 - Process Improvement: Strong process-improvement mindset with the ability to identify workflow breakdowns, design and implement practical solutions, and measure whether changes improve efficiency, quality, and conversion.

 - Data & Performance Management: Data-informed leader who can translate performance metrics into action, identify trends and breakdowns, establish accountability, and use insights to improve individual and team performance.

 - Family & Referral Partner Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to communicate warmly and confidently with families and referring providers, personally navigate complex or escalated situations, and build trust without pressure.

 - Cross-Functional Leadership: Strong ability to work across teams and influence without direct authority, partnering effectively with Site Directors, Operations, Business Development, and clinical leaders to align family demand, service capacity, and enrollment priorities.

 - Relevant Service Experience: Experience in ABA, behavioral health, healthcare, patient access, admissions, or another high-touch service environment preferred, with an understanding of the importance of responsiveness, accuracy, and empathy throughout the client journey.

 - Ability to pass a background check (Required).

 

Perks and Benefits:

 - Industry benchmarked, competitive pay
   
   - Salary $80,000 - $100,000 per year, depending on experience

 - Twenty-nine paid days off

 - Medical, Vision, Dental- 80% Employee, 50% Dependents

 - Life, AD&D, Accident, Hospital Indemnity, Short Term Disability, and Critical Illness Insurance

 - Protect your pet with discounted pet insurance

 - Secure your future with our 401k program

 - Monthly CEU Trainings

 - Tuition discounts available to all employees through our University Partnerships

jobs.title: Staff+ Software Engineer, Distributed Systems
jobs.location: New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are looking for software engineers to help build safety and oversight mechanisms for our AI systems. As a software engineer on the Safeguards team, you will work to monitor models, prevent misuse, and ensure user well-being. This role will focus on building systems to detect unwanted model behaviors and prevent disallowed use of models. You will apply your technical skills to uphold our principles of safety, transparency, and oversight while enforcing our terms of service and acceptable use policies.

Responsibilities:

• Develop monitoring systems to detect unwanted behaviors from our API partners and potentially take automated enforcement actions; surface these in internal dashboards to analysts for manual review

• Stand up and run deployments of those monitoring systems across multiple clouds, including inside cloud-provider partner environments where data must stay in place. Keep the deployments consistent through shared deployment pipelines, smoke tests, observability, and alerting

• Design and harden the sandboxed runtime that AI agents execute in: isolation, network egress controls, least-privilege data access, audit logging, and insider-risk controls

• Manage cost and capacity for large volumes of long-running agent work, and set and meet service-level objectives for the platform

• Partner with the engineers and researchers who write and evaluate the monitoring agents, and with security, privacy, and legal teams, so new detection work can ship quickly on a platform everyone trusts

You may be a good fit if you:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or comparable experience

• Proficiency in Python, Distributed Systems, and Infrastructure as Code

• Have worked across multiple cloud providers, or built infrastructure designed to be provider-agnostic

• Have built and operated large-scale, distributed infrastructure, such as data platforms, control planes, or job schedulers

• Have experience with sandboxing and isolation technologies (containers, microVMs, network policy) or with a systems language such as Rust

• Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

Strong candidates may also:

• 8+ years of experience in a software engineering position

• Have built systems that handle sensitive or regulated data, with requirements around access control, auditability, retention, and data residency

• Have experience running LLM-based agents in production

• Have experience with integrity, spam, fraud, or abuse detection and mitigation

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$320,000—$485,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Marketing Director - H&N Cancer
jobs.description:
CareDx is a leading precision medicine diagnostics company advancing care in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy. Through our innovative portfolio of molecular diagnostics, digital health solutions, AI-powered data and analytics, and patient support services, we partner with healthcare providers, patients, and biopharma organizations to help inform clinical decision-making and improve patient outcomes.

Within CareDx's Specialty Oncology business, we are focused on improving the management of HPV-driven cancers through innovative diagnostic solutions. NavDx®, our blood-based DNA test, helps clinicians detect molecular signs of disease recurrence, monitor treatment response, and guide patient management throughout the care journey. Our team is committed to expanding access to actionable insights that support more informed cancer care.

CareDx is seeking a strategic, hands-on Marketing Director to lead marketing for NavDx within the Specialty Oncology franchise. This leader will own the integrated brand strategy and execution needed to build awareness, strengthen clinical belief, accelerate adoption, and support consistent utilization of NavDx across the management and monitoring of HPV-driven cancers. A primary focus of the role will be expanding adoption in both HPV-driven head & neck cancer, while supporting the long-term growth of the franchise through new contexts of use, indication expansion, and broader integration of NavDx across the cancer care continuum.

The role requires a strong understanding of oncology diagnostics, clinical evidence, provider decision-making, and the operational steps required to move from initial awareness to sustained ordering behavior. The Marketing Director will partner closely with Sales, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Market Access, Digital, Sales Training, Product, and Medical-Legal-Regulatory partners to develop and execute strategies that drive adoption, expand ordering-provider reach, increase utilization, and convert market insights into measurable commercial impact.

Responsibilities:

• Brand Strategy and Annual Planning: Develop and execute an integrated, insight-driven marketing strategy for the specialty oncology franchise. Own the annual marketing plan and multi-year brand roadmap, aligned with Specialty Oncology growth objectives, evolving evidence, market access priorities, customer needs, and patient journey.

• Market Development and Adoption: Design initiatives that expand appropriate NavDx adoption across priority HPV-driven cancers and care settings. Identify barriers to testing, segment customers by opportunity and readiness, and develop strategies that increase ordering-provider reach, reactivate lapsed users, deepen utilization, and support integration into patient-management workflows.

• Commercial Focus and Indication Expansion: Translate franchise priorities into focused commercial plans for established and emerging use cases. Support continued growth in head and neck cancer as evidence, market readiness, and organizational priorities evolve.

• Customer and Market Insights: Use quantitative and qualitative insights, including sales performance, ordering behavior, market research, competitive intelligence, field feedback, KOL input, and customer journey analysis, to identify opportunities, sharpen segmentation, and guide investment decisions.

• Positioning, Messaging, and Promotional Execution: Develop differentiated positioning and compelling messaging for healthcare professionals, care teams, KOLs, patients, and other relevant stakeholders. Lead the creation and deployment of field tools, sales aids, digital campaigns, speaker materials, email content, website content, objection handlers, and competitive resources that are clinically grounded and action oriented.

• Clinical Evidence Translation: Partner with Medical Affairs and Clinical Development to translate complex clinical and scientific evidence into clear, compliant, and differentiated marketing strategies. Connect evidence milestones to customer education, adoption barriers, market development, and broader commercial opportunities.

• Field Enablement and Sales Partnership: Collaborate closely with Sales and Sales Training to equip customer-facing teams with clear strategies, effective tools, and consistent messaging. Establish feedback loops that capture field insight, inform rapid-response materials, and improve execution in priority accounts and territories.

• Omnichannel and Digital Marketing: In collaboration with the digital marketing center of excellence, develop coordinated personal and non-personal promotion that reaches customers with relevant content at the right point in their adoption journey. Use engagement data and customer behavior to refine channel mix, content sequencing, and campaign effectiveness.

• Performance Measurement and Resource Allocation: Define KPIs and dashboards that connect marketing activity to business outcomes, including awareness, engagement, ordering-provider growth, customer activation or reactivation, utilization, and campaign effectiveness. Evaluate ROI, optimize spend, and redirect resources toward the highest-impact opportunities.

• Cross-Functional Leadership and Agency Management: Lead through influence across Marketing, Sales, Medical Affairs, Clinical, Market Access, Digital, Product, Compliance, and Operations. Provide agencies and creative partners with clear briefs, strategic context, brand standards, and actionable feedback to ensure high-quality, timely execution.

• Compliance and Budget Management: Lead materials through Medical-Legal-Regulatory review and ensure clinical accuracy, brand consistency, and compliance with applicable requirements and company policies. Own budget planning, forecasting, tracking, and prioritization while maintaining flexibility to respond to market shifts, new evidence, and competitive activity.

Minimum Education, Experience, & Specialized Knowledge (Required):

• Marketing Experience - At least 8-10 years of relevant marketing experience in diagnostics, biotech, pharma, or medical device industries, with a proven track record of leadership and strategic impact. Strong background in developing strategic, data-driven marketing plans for complex diagnostic or therapeutic products. A proven track record of engaging healthcare professionals (HCPs), key opinion leaders (KOLs), and cross-functional teams, translating clinical data into compelling promotional messaging. Applies market insights to inform pipeline strategy and optimize lifecycle planning. Familiarity with market research methodologies and able to lead complex research projects. Experience leading multichannel campaigns, including digital and social media, and navigating the MLR review process in a highly regulated environment is essential. Additionally, this marketer must be comfortable with budget management, agency collaboration, and driving protocol adherence and pull-through.

• Health Care/Life Sciences – Experience in Oncology disease state and a HCP-facing healthcare environment is strongly preferred—ideally in Specialty Therapeutics, Diagnostics, Genomics, Life Sciences. Familiarity with HIPAA compliance, data privacy regulations, and the MLR review process is essential. Candidates should have a proven ability to translate complex clinical or scientific data into clear, impactful marketing strategies that drive adoption, adherence, and behavior change across both HCP and patient audiences. Backgrounds in Pharmaceuticals, Medical Devices, or Chronic and Rare Disease marketing are also highly relevant, particularly given their similar stakeholder complexity, patient engagement needs, and regulatory demands.

• Leadership & Cross-Functional Influence – The Specialty Oncology Marketing Director must be a strong peer leader, self-starter, and collaborator that works effectively across Product, Sales, Clinical, Medical Affairs, and Regulatory to ensure promotional content is clinically accurate, compliant, and strategically aligned. The ideal candidate excels at turning strategy into action, driving alignment across stakeholder groups, and executing initiatives that support both revenue growth and improved patient outcomes. Success in this role requires the ability to influence without authority and thrive in a matrixed, mission-driven organization.

• Education - A Bachelor’s degree is required, with a strong preference for candidates who hold a BA/BS in Life Sciences, Molecular Biology, or Clinical Science, reflecting a solid foundation in healthcare or scientific disciplines relevant to CareDx’s mission. An MBA or other advanced degree is also preferred, demonstrating advanced training in strategic thinking, business acumen, and cross-functional leadership—key attributes for driving impact in a complex, data-driven, and highly regulated healthcare environment.

Required Core Competencies

• Strategic Agility - comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving clarity in complex landscapes

• Drive for Results in dynamic, fast-paced setting

• Leadership

• Collaboration and Teamwork

• Innovative thinking

About Pulley

Pulley helps the country’s top architects, builders, and retailers speed up every project in their portfolio. With AI-powered permitting intelligence and expert guidance, we eliminate costly delays and bring predictability across the full lifecycle of commercial projects.

We support rollout programs for brands like J.Crew, Solidcore, and Hibbett Sports, as well as major data center buildouts, EV charging networks, and other commercial projects. Our platform dramatically reduces approval timelines, improves forecasting accuracy, and removes thousands of hours of manual work from design and construction teams.

Founded in 2021, Pulley combines deep permitting expertise with purpose-built AI from people who have created products used by millions. We’re backed by CRV, Susa Ventures, Fifth Wall, and leaders from Plaid, Segment, ServiceTitan, and Procore.

jobs.title: Field Reimbursement Manager
jobs.description:
Location: Remote, Central US
Reports To: Head, Market Access

About This Role:

The Field Reimbursement Manager plays a critical role in facilitating patient access to new therapies by leveraging their expertise in coverage, payer policies, and patient assistance programs. Through education and partnership with office staff, they help navigate the access journey and identify solutions.

This role is customer facing and will provide personalized issue resolution by partnering closely with the dedicated patient support (hub) and specialty pharmacy team. They will also collaborate closely with local/regional sales teams supporting targeted accounts, ensuring patients and providers experience minimal barriers to access.

This role will support accounts located in Texas, Missouri, Illinois, Michigan, Wisconsin, and Minnesota.

What You'll Do:

• Demonstrate deep understanding of reimbursement and access and act as the subject matter expert in their assigned territory.

• Demonstrate extensive knowledge of individual managed care account’s geographic presence/influence, payer mix, product coverage and reimbursement criteria policies.

• Educate providers on prior authorization requirements, coverage status, payer appeals requirements, alternate funding options for the uninsured and under insured, and all associated processes and timelines.

• Provide access education to HCPs and office staff as needed

• Serve as a liaison between sales reps and key external customers.

• Create and maintain productive relationships with HCPs, key stakeholders within HCP offices, and health care systems.

• Utilize knowledge to assist customers in navigating the complexity of specialty pharmacy distribution.

• Partner daily with the specialty pharmacy case management team to ensure accurate coverage determinations, and optimized processing of enrollments for timely access of product for patients.

• Partner with the sales team and patient hub/SP to identify both accounts that are experiencing reimbursement issues and specific patients that are not moving forward due to insurance delays.

• Develop and implement innovative solutions for patient access with system and individual situations.

• Perform strategic analyses to develop business plans that identify issues and opportunities.

• Role involves significant travel (up to approximately 70% of time). The Field Reimbursement Manager will meet customers, attend appropriate conferences, and is expected to travel in the field with sales and regional colleagues to call upon key providers and influencers.

Required Skills:

• B.S./B.A. degree or higher and 8+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with expertise in biotech drug distribution across specialty distributors, specialty pharmacies, and hospital systems.

• Demonstrated understanding of coverage and reimbursement for oral and injectable therapies.

• Strong expertise in Specialty Pharmacy operations and third-party services (Patient Support).

• Deep knowledge of payer/PBM utilization management tactics for new therapies such as new to market blocks and exclusion lists required.

• Extensive understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturer compliance, patient confidentiality, product reimbursement and product access requirements

• Knowledge of regulations and laws governing the protection of patient identifying information, and relevant laws, regulations, and policies pertaining to access offerings

• Demonstrates a strong sense of urgency and self-motivation, ensuring successful achievement of company goals and objectives through clear and concise written/verbal communication.

• Strong cross-functional influencer with experience partnering across commercial, medical, clinical, and external stakeholder groups.

• A true team player, with the ability to adapt to changing environments, balance competing priorities, and respond to ambiguity and unforeseen challenges with maturity, professionalism, and sound judgment.

• Extensive knowledge of laws and regulations that govern contracting and pricing for pharmaceutical products.

• Experience managing long-term enterprise-level relationships, and driving complex contract negotiations and contracts pull-through

• Deep understanding and compliance with the OIG and FDA regulations governing pharmaceutical marketing and the PhRMA code.

• Excellent communication skills with stakeholders at all levels of the organization; possessing a persuasive and credible presentation style.

Preferred Skills:

• Launch experience, specifically of oral specialty drugs is highly valued; Rare disease experience is a plus.

• Experience in and understanding of other commercial functions (e.g., marketing, market access, sales, insights/analytics, etc.) will be an important consideration for this role.

Additional Information:

The base compensation range for this role is: $185,000 - $215,000. Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills & experience, job location, and internal equity.

jobs.title: Distribution System Planner
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking an experienced Distribution System Planner to support a diverse range of clients, including electric utilities, developers, government agencies, and other infrastructure stakeholders in planning safe, reliable, resilient, and future-ready energy and distribution systems.

This is a hands-on technical position focused on electric distribution system planning, grid modernization, and infrastructure analysis. Responsibilities include load forecasting, capacity and infrastructure planning, system performance and reliability assessments, distributed energy resource (DER) integration, transportation and building electrification studies, microgrid and resilience planning, non-wires alternatives evaluations, and development of capital investment strategies. The role may also support broader energy transition initiatives, including decarbonization planning, renewable energy integration, and long-range infrastructure planning.

The successful candidate will be capable of independently performing technical analyses and planning studies, developing actionable infrastructure and investment recommendations, and collaborating directly with client planning, engineering, operations, sustainability, and asset management teams. The ideal candidate will combine strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to communicate complex technical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, helping organizations make informed decisions about future energy and infrastructure investments.

The job responsibilities for the position will include but are not limited to:

• Perform near-term and long-range distribution system and energy infrastructure planning studies
• Develop, maintain, and validate distribution network and energy system planning models
• Evaluate electrical distribution assets, including feeders, transformers, substations, and customer-owned infrastructure, for capacity, performance, and future growth requirements
• Perform distribution load flow, voltage, thermal loading, contingency, and related system analyses
• Identify existing and future infrastructure constraints, operational challenges, and capacity limitations
• Develop and evaluate technically viable infrastructure alternatives to support reliability, growth, electrification, and decarbonization objectives
• Evaluate feeder reinforcement, reconductoring, new feeders, substation expansion, voltage improvements, switching/configuration changes, and other distribution system solutions
• Support development of multi-year capital improvement, infrastructure investment, and asset management plan
• Develop and evaluate load and energy forecasts at the distribution level
• Assess impacts of customer growth, transportation electrification, building electrification, data centers and other large loads, distributed generation, and energy storage
• Translate load forecasts into feeder and substation capacity requirements
• Perform scenario and sensitivity analyses to address uncertainty in future load growth
• Evaluate the impacts and opportunities associated with DERs, distributed generation, renewable energy, and energy storage technologies
• Perform or support hosting capacity, interconnection, and grid integration studies
• Evaluate battery storage, EV charging, microgrids, and other distributed technologies
• Support Integrated Distribution Planning and evaluation of traditional infrastructure and non-wires alternatives
• Evaluate reliability, resilience, and operational performance of electric distribution and energy delivery systems
• Identify opportunities to improve system sectionalization, redundancy, transfer capability, and operational flexibility
• Support distribution resilience, wildfire mitigation, undergrounding, and system-hardening planning where applicable
• Coordinate planning recommendations with distribution operations, protection, engineering, asset management, and field organizations
• Develop project need statements and technical justifications for distribution capital projects
• Develop conceptual alternatives, planning-level cost estimates, and investment recommendations
• Support capital prioritization and risk-based investment planning
• Prepare technical reports, presentations, planning studies, and recommendations
• Participate in technical discussions and workshops with utility clients
• Support technical proposals and scopes of work
• Coordinate with other AECOM engineering, advisory, program management, environmental, and digital disciplines as required

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

• BA/BS in Electrical Engineering or Power Systems Engineering + 6 years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
• 6 years of related experience in electric utility distribution planning, distribution system analysis, or closely related power-system planning experience.
• Demonstrated hands-on experience performing distribution system planning studies
• Experience with CYME, Synergi Electric, WindMil, ETAP, or comparable distribution analysis software
• Demonstrated knowledge of distribution load flow, voltage, thermal capacity, contingency, and reliability analysis
• Experience evaluating feeder and/or substation capacity requirements and developing system improvement alternatives

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Masters Degree in Electrical Engineering or Power Systems Engineering
• Professional Engineer (PE) license or progress toward licensure
• Prior electric utility distribution-planning experience
• Advanced experience with CYME and/or Synergi Electric
• Experience with distribution load forecasting tools and methodologies
• Experience with DER, EV, energy storage, hosting-capacity, and electrification studies
• Experience with integrated distribution planning and non-wires alternatives
• Familiarity with GIS, SCADA, AMI, ADMS, DERMS, or other utility systems and data sources used to support distribution planning
• Python, SQL, Power BI, or other data-analysis/automation experience
• Experience developing distribution capital plans or supporting utility regulatory filings
• Strong analytical, technical-writing, and client-communication skills

• Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.
• Relocation is not available for this position.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

About Us

The Virtual Preparatory Academy of Indiana @ Madison-Grant is a K–12 tuition-free online public school in the state of Indiana. We believe in empowering students by providing a flexible, innovative education at home, where state-certified teachers work closely with families to ensure each child reaches their full potential at their own pace.

We are seeking teachers who are excited to create a rigorous and nurturing classroom environment that prioritizes student learning and social-emotional development. ACCEL Schools uses a cutting-edge 21st-century curriculum, which can be accessed online and through a variety of traditional methods.

Please note – while this is an online school position and all instruction occurs virtually, travel and face to face attendance will be required several times per year to support in person state testing and student events.

About the Opportunity

• Serve as the teacher of record and primary instructor

• Relentlessly work to meet all goals related to student achievement and culture as well as state specific academic accountability goals

Consistently ranked among the nation’s top firms, we take pride in solving complex challenges with forward-thinking solutions.

About Orlando

Located in the heart of Orlando’s Baldwin Park district, BRPH’s Orlando office is a dynamic regional hub supporting some of our most innovative work across education, entertainment, hospitality, and commercial markets. Our Orlando team brings together architects, engineers, designers, and project specialists in a highly collaborative environment that values creativity, technical excellence, and client service.

Overview

BRPH is a full-service architecture, engineering, and construction services firm specializing in state-of-the-art facility design with offices from coast to coast. With roots in Florida’s Space Coast and aerospace industry, BRPH is committed to driving innovation every day. Over the past 60 years, we’ve grown to include services in the Education, Entertainment, Hospitality, Interiors, and Manufacturing markets, and our cross-market experience means that our clients always receive well-rounded and innovative service. Through our unique approaches to the world’s most complex architecture and engineering problems, we move the world forward together.

Job Responsibilities

We are looking for students who are interested in gaining skills and knowledge in building design and construction and exploring future career opportunities. All Interns will work alongside professionals in a setting that provides you invaluable experience applying the knowledge and skills learned through your education in a business environment. Our interns will be mentored by an engineer where they will learn fundamentals of design, our markets and clients, attend project site visits, and build your software skills. If you are looking for an internship with an incredible group of talented and enthusiastic people, then this is the perfect opportunity for you.

Qualifications

jobs.description:

We are committed to developing our people through structured career pathways that foster professional growth and leadership development.

Role Overview

The Advisory Manager – Systems Engineering combines leadership of active client engagements with direct participation in growth, opportunity shaping, and pursuit support activities.

The Advisory Manager will independently lead defined engagements or major workstreams, manage client relationships at the program level, and contribute meaningfully to pipeline development and competitive pursuits.

This individual will bring a strong systems engineering background and apply structured problem-solving, analytical rigor, executive communication, and disciplined execution methodologies to complex federal environments. Success in this role requires the ability to balance delivery accountability with proactive support to growth efforts—translating client insight into opportunity pathways and helping convert positioned work into funded engagements.

Key Responsibilities

Engagement Leadership & Delivery Execution

• Lead day-to-day execution of advisory engagements, managing scope, schedule, milestones, and client communications.
• Independently structure and manage workplans, risk logs, staffing coordination, and deliverable production.
• Serve as the primary delivery lead for defined engagements or major task areas.
• Produce executive-ready analyses, briefings, transformation roadmaps, and governance artifacts.
• Coordinate internal SMEs and cross-functional teams to ensure cohesive and timely outputs.
• Identify performance risks and implement mitigation strategies to sustain delivery excellence.

Advisory Growth & Capture Contribution

• Contribute to growth initiatives through opportunity research, solution structuring, and capture support.
• Develop work breakdown structures, staffing models, and execution roadmaps for proposal responses.
• Draft and refine technical volumes, management approaches, and value propositions.
• Support competitive positioning efforts through market analysis and client insight development.
• Identify follow-on and adjacent opportunities within active engagements.

Analytical Rigor & Structured Problem Solving

• Apply formal management consulting methodologies to assess operational challenges, governance gaps, and organizational performance constraints.
• Conduct qualitative and quantitative analyses to support strategy development and implementation planning.
• Translate complex policy, acquisition, and operational inputs into actionable recommendations.
• Develop performance metrics, dashboards, implementation frameworks, and executive summaries.
• Structure ambiguous federal challenges into clear, implementable solution pathways.

Client Engagement & Stakeholder Coordination

• Serve as a trusted day-to-day client interface at the program or task level.
• Facilitate workshops, stakeholder alignment sessions, and executive working groups.
• Maintain strong working relationships with federal program managers and operational leads.

• Experienced independently structuring ambiguous problems using formal consulting methodologies (e.g., issue trees, hypothesis-driven analysis, operating model design, governance frameworks).
• Experience delivering executive-level products, including strategic plans, operating models, performance frameworks, and modernization roadmaps.
• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills consistent with consulting standards.

Preferred Background

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst I, Medical Affairs
jobs.description:
Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health.

Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.

Our AI-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.

As an AI-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.

We are hiring a Senior Data Analyst within our Business Intelligence organization to work with our Medical Affairs team. The Medical Affairs team is dedicated to clinical improvement of our members and quality assurance of our providers. In this role, you will serve as a key cross-functional data partner working with Quality, Product, and the Chief Medical Officer. You will work closely with Medical Affairs leadership to define KPIs, track outcomes, and conduct exploratory analyses that drive strategic decision-making and program evolution. A key competency for this role is an exceptional ability to translate technical work and ideas into language that clinicians can easily understand. You’ll operate in a cross functional data team that includes data scientists and analytics engineers, all of whom are working towards this goal with you. This is a full time, remote position on our team reporting to the Associate Director, Analytics. Occasional travel may be required for company or team meetings/events.

What you’ll do:

• Partner with the Medical Affairs team to define, refine, and evolve key metrics and KPIs as the program scales across new conditions and services.

• Build, document, and maintain dashboards and data visualizations in business intelligence tools (ex: Omni & Hex) that empower non-technical users to monitor clinical outcomes and provider quality.

• Conduct exploratory and ad-hoc analyses to answer emerging business and clinical questions.

• Identify trends and gaps in clinical improvement & initiatives and recommend opportunities for improvement based on data-driven insights.

• Support data integrity efforts by contributing to dbt models and ensuring consistent, scalable data structures across Medical Affairs.

• Partner with data, product, and engineering teams to ensure the Medical Affairs team has access to the necessary data sources for comprehensive reporting.

• Serve as a data advisor and thought partner for Medical Affairs leadership, proactively shaping how success is measured and informing future strategic initiatives.

• Partner with the data science team to dive deeper into major trends, helping us understand what is driving those changes.

• Ensure downstream teams can access and utilize data effectively by providing training, documentation and support for the dashboards and data products you deliver.

• Ensure accurate and consistent reporting and documentation of metrics, collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure data alignment across the business.

• Work with our analytics engineering team to maintain the core data models in dbt that support these metrics and ensure data consistency.

• Utilize an AI-forward approach, understand key machine learning concepts, and analyze data derived from these technologies to drive clinical and operational insights.

• Lead meetings with stakeholders on a consistent cadence to update them on the status of work and bandwidth along with sending timely updates on communication channels including (but not limited to) Jira tickets and Slack.

What success looks like in this role:

• Develop tools and analyses that enable the teams you work with to hit their own KPIs - you’re successful when you help your team be successful!

• Reduce the amount of time teams spend manually pulling data to inform decisions

• Develop dashboards and analyses that deliver ongoing value to teams, measured in proxy by the number of monthly active users and total views different dashboards and analyses receive.

• Contribute to our foundational data model by adding additional fields and tables according to our data style guide

What you’ll bring:

• You are passionate about changing the face of mental health care and Spring Health’s mission to remove all barriers to mental health resonates with you

• You are an early adopter of AI and automation tools, you actively experiment with LLMs, AI-assisted analytics, and emerging tooling to accelerate your work and surface insights faster.

• You have 5+ years of working experience working with data, data visualization, and dashboarding tools

• You are an expert in SQL, and have at least familiarity with dbt or similar data transformation tools

• You have exceptional communication skills, are comfortable explaining technical concepts to a non-technical audience, and are comfortable working independently with executive level team members

• You have strong user empathy - you are curious and collaborative, working closely with stakeholders to deeply understand their core challenges and translate them into data solutions that meaningfully improve their ability to operate.

• You have experience working with Omni, Hex or other similar data visualization tools (tableau, etc), both creating the data model and building dashboards

• You focus on impact, finding the things you can deliver that provide the most value for your stakeholders

• You are humble, highly motivated, and thrive in fast-paced environments

• You have a proven ability to proactively manage your own priorities and dependencies in alignment with cross-functional dependencies and product/business impact

• You have a passion for successfully navigating ambiguous problem areas and learning new approaches

• You are comfortable working in a fast paced environment and navigating changing priorities with multiple stakeholders.

The target base salary range for this position is $125,000 - $142,000 and is part of a competitive total rewards package including equity and benefits. jobs.title: Emergency Veterinary Assistant (Part-Time) - Overland Park, KS
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

At VEG, we don’t just hire assistants—we grow future emergency rockstars. As a part-time Emergency Veterinary Assistant, you’ll be in the heart of the action from day one, supporting your team, comforting pet parents, and learning the ropes in real time. You’ll be there for everything—the triage, the treatments, and the tail wags. You’re embarking on a path where careers start, grow, and thrive. Whether you’re on your way to becoming a credentialed technician or exploring where your passion can take you, we’ll say yes to your growth every step of the way.

WHAT YOU’LL DO*

• Be the first warm welcome and a steady support, triaging incoming patients and helping guide them toward care

• Assist with treatments, nursing care, and diagnostics, from bloodwork and imaging to catheter placement and oxygen support

• Work alongside our credentialed veterinary technicians and veterinarians to set up and monitor anesthesia and sedation cases

• Set up and manage IV fluids, blood transfusions, and medication administration

• Assist during every moment of care: outpatient or inpatient, exam room to treatment area.

• Join patient rounds and stay close to the clinical picture to ensure continuity of care.

• Learn how to perform CPR and become a RECOVER Certified Rescuer (training provided!)

• Grow into more advanced responsibilities, such as anesthesia support, ultrasound, and catheterization through guided training pathways

*As permitted by state law

WHAT YOU NEED

• High school diploma or equivalent required

• Enrolled in an AVMA-accredited veterinary technology program a plus

• 1+ years in a veterinary assistant role (emergency or specialty experience is a bonus!)

• Basic computer skills and an understanding of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator when collaborating with pet parents and your team

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation

• A BIG focus on learning and growth from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to Unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (No really!). Part-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend. Part-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $400/year travel stipend

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Manager, Electrical Engineering
jobs.description:
Hyliion is committed to creating innovative solutions that enable clean, flexible and affordable electricity production. The Company’s primary focus is to develop distributed power generators that can operate on various fuel sources to future-proof against an ever-changing energy economy.

Job Purpose

The Manager, Electrical Engineering is responsible for the electrical systems of the KARNO generator, including high-voltage power electronics, battery systems, low- and high-voltage architecture, wiring harnesses, and the hardware that converts linear motion into electrical output. This is a working manager role: the position leads and develops a team of electrical engineers while remaining directly involved in technical execution, including circuit architecture, schematic review, and hardware bring-up in the lab. The Manager is accountable for the technical excellence, safety, and reliability of the electrical engineering function, and for establishing the design standards and review practices the team works to. The position plans team capacity, owns hiring and development for the electrical engineering staff, and partners with mechanical, controls, supply chain, and program management on system integration. KARNO systems are deployed in data center, military, and industrial applications.

AI at Hyliion

At Hyliion, AI is core to how we work. We equip every team member with leading AI tools and count on you to use them — to move faster, solve harder problems, and help us realize the full potential of KARNO technology for the world.

Duties and Responsibilities

• Own critical electrical designs personally, including regular time at the bench and in the test cell, while leading the team as a practicing engineer.

• Lead the electrical engineering team in the design and development of KARNO generator electrical systems, including high-voltage power electronics, battery systems, linear generator power stages, and low-voltage controls hardware, ensuring effective integration with mechanical, electromechanical, and control elements.

• Architect and oversee the design and execution of electrical hardware, control modules, and system-level solutions, ensuring a cohesive and integrated development approach.

• Integrate electrical and control modules into final products and collaborate with suppliers to ensure compliance with quality, performance, and safety requirements.

• Define electrical design requirements and technical best practices, ensuring both electrical and control components align with industry standards for hybrid power generation.

• Translate system requirements into electrical system- and sub-system specifications, supporting seamless integration across industrial and commercial applications.

• Lead, coach, and develop the electrical engineering team, fostering a collaborative, innovative, and high-performing work environment.

• Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development for electrical engineers, including setting individual goals and conducting regular performance reviews.

• Plan team capacity and assign engineering work across programs, balancing workload, skill development, and technical priorities.

• Establish and maintain electrical engineering standards, design review practices, and documentation processes across the team.

• Ensure compliance with applicable safety and regulatory standards for electrical systems used in hybrid generator products.

• Serve as the electrical engineering point of contact for program management and cross-functional teams, including mechanical, controls, and supply chain, providing technical input, effort estimates, and engineering deliverables.

• Lead technical issue resolution at the hardware and component level, working hands-on in the lab, organizing troubleshooting efforts, conducting root cause analysis, and implementing corrective actions to improve system reliability.

• Achieve system cost targets through design optimization, module consolidation, and strategic supplier selection for production components.

• Provide technical direction to electrical component suppliers in support of design, prototyping, and testing, in partnership with supply chain.

• Lead the development of quality and validation documentation, including FMEAs and DVP&Rs, to ensure system reliability and safety.

• Personally develop and review schematics and release drawings for low- and high-voltage wiring harnesses and associated electrical systems.

• Provide strategic direction for electrical design decisions, ensuring electrical components meet performance, cost, and regulatory requirements for industrial and commercial use.

• Additional duties and responsibilities as assigned, needed, or required for the business.

Qualifications

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Qualifications include:

• Education, Experience and Certifications Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering. 10+ years of hands-on electrical engineering experience, including 3+ years leading or managing engineers while remaining technically active. Track record of delivering electrical hardware, including power electronics, high-voltage systems, or electromechanical products, from concept through production.

• Skills and Abilities Hands-on electrical engineering capability, including circuit design, hardware build and test, and bench-level debugging, combined with the ability to lead and develop a team. High-voltage power electronics design, including AC/DC and DC/DC converters and battery systems. Low- and high-voltage wiring harness design. Electrical hardware architecture and circuit design for electromechanical systems. Knowledge of and compliance with applicable electrical and safety standards. Experience with real-time control systems, including PLCs and microcontrollers. Systems engineering and structured product development processes. Electrical hardware design, optimization, and cost reduction. Prototyping, testing, and validation using tools such as FMEA and DVP&R. Technical engagement with suppliers of electrical components. Definition of high-level design requirements and internal engineering standards. Hiring, performance management, and career development of engineering staff. Ability to balance cost, performance, and regulatory requirements. Familiarity with relevant electrical safety standards, including IEC and UL. Ability to translate customer and system requirements into clear product specifications. Quality assurance and control for electrical and control systems. Promotion of creative problem-solving within multidisciplinary teams. Clear communication of technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Effective cross-functional collaboration across engineering disciplines. Strong analytical skills for diagnosing and resolving complex technical issues. Leadership in root cause analysis and implementation of corrective actions. Mentoring and coaching of electrical engineers. Building and leading high-performing engineering teams. Bias for action and comfort with the pace and ambiguity of bringing a first-of-its-kind product to market.

Role Classification and Working Conditions

This is a salaried, exempt-level position. This position typically works in a production/assembly/engineering lab environment.

Physical/Other Requirements

• Ability to lift and/or move up to 30 pounds.

• Ability to travel, as needed, by plane, automobile, etc.

Direct Reports

This position has or may have direct reports.

• Verifies conformance of parts to stock list and blueprints using measuring instruments such as calipers, gauges, and micrometers. Inspect parts to quality standards.
• Aligns components for assembly, manually or with a crane.
• Removes high spots and smooths surfaces using chisels, scrapers, files, and powered hand grinder. Assemble, set up, and operates machines to verify functionality, machine capabilities, and conformance to customer’s specifications.
• Form, bend, and fasten piping, fixtures, and attachments required to provide the machine with air, water, and oil. May bend and install pipe for hydraulic systems.
• Verifies alignment and tolerances of moving parts using measuring instruments such as dial indicators and micrometers.
• Installs moving parts such as shafts, levers, or bearings, and works them to test free movement and operation of assembly by hand. Test or assist in testing operation of completed product.
• Align and mesh gears in gearbox to assemble system of gears.
• Mounts and connects auxiliary, mechanical, electrical, electronic, pneumatic, or hydraulic equipment. Cuts and fits pipes and tubing.
• Test, or assist in testing, operation of completed product.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Solid mechanical skills. Must have mechanical ability to proficiently use cranes and other heavy tools and equipment that are normally required in daily assembly and disassembly operations.
• Must own tools of the trade, and be able to use them effectively.
• Ability to use judgment to plan, perform, and make decisions as to the sequence of operations and processes within the limitations of established or standard methods and procedures.
• Must be able to interpret prints well enough to determine appropriate disassembly sequence for a variety of heavy equipment.
• Ability to read, interpret a variety of assembly prints, and understand verbal and written instructions.
• Capable of using small machine tools, drill presses, welders, cranes, and forklifts.
• Basic computer skills and the ability to use basic shop math.
• Ability to verbally communicate with team members, supervisors, and engineers.
• Possess the physical strength and ability to safely handle heavy equipment and tools.
• Ability to bend tubing, lube, hydraulics, and pneumatics.

Required Education and Experience

• A high school diploma or equivalent.
• 3-5 years’ experience in mechanical assembly and disassembly.

Environment and Working Conditions

• Shop environment.

Travel Requirements (percent)

• Up to 10%

Shift: 1st Shift - 6:30 am-5:00 pm

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Technical Recruiting
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

What You'll Do:

CoreWeave's Talent Acquisition team is scaling recruiting and sourcing leadership to keep pace with our hyper-growth. This role owns technical/engineering recruiting for John Mancuso's org — bringing structure, consistency, and strategic direction to a team that's currently more distributed than our growth demands. You'll eventually report into our incoming Director of Business Recruiting as that leadership layer comes online.

About the Role:

As Sr. Manager, Recruiting, you'll lead a pod of technical and engineering-focused recruiters and sourcers, owning full-cycle hiring outcomes for some of CoreWeave's most competitive technical roles. You'll partner directly with senior engineering stakeholders to translate hiring needs into sourcing strategy, bring operational rigor to a team that's ready for it, and build the systems (pipeline reviews, capacity planning, reporting) that let us scale predictably. This is a build role: you're not stepping into a mature machine, you're building one.

In this role, you will:

• Build and lead a high-performing pod of technical/engineering recruiters and sourcers

• Partner directly with senior engineering leaders to turn hiring needs into effective pipeline strategy

• Establish a consistent operating cadence — pipeline reviews, capacity planning, reporting — across the team

• Drive measurable improvement in pipeline health, time-to-fill, and conversion rates using data

• Coach and develop recruiters and sourcers, raising the bar on execution and judgment

• Own end-to-end hiring outcomes for technical/engineering roles across the org

• Partner with People, Comp, and HRBP stakeholders on leveling, offers, and calibration

Who You Are:

• 5+ years of full-cycle technical/engineering recruiting experience, including experience in a people-management or team-lead capacity

• Proven experience leading a recruiting and/or sourcing team (pod, team, or org) in a high-growth environment

• Demonstrated track record hiring technical/engineering talent (software engineers, applied scientists, infrastructure, or similar) at scale

• Experience partnering directly with senior technical stakeholders (VP+ or equivalent)

• Hands-on experience using recruiting data and metrics (pipeline conversion, time-to-fill) to drive process improvements

• Able to work from the New York City area

Preferred:

• Experience recruiting specifically within AI/ML or infrastructure engineering domains

• Experience standing up or improving recruiting operations/tooling (ATS workflows, sourcing tech stack)

• You're energized by ambiguity and enjoy building structure where none exists yet

• You're a "player-coach" — just as comfortable recruiting hands-on as you are coaching a team

• You're curious about AI infrastructure and want to deepen your domain expertise

• You bring data-driven rigor without losing the relationship-building side of recruiting

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We're in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. • Act Like an Owner

• Empower Employees

• Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences

• Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!
