jobs.title: Software Engineer | API
jobs.description:
MEET DEEPL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.




WHAT SETS US APART

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/deepl/,Instagram https://www.instagram.com/deepl_official/, and our Blog https://www.deepl.com/en/blog.


MEET THE TEAM BEHIND THIS JOURNEY

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the API Core team. For us, the API is the product. We are the bridge connecting DeepL's bleeding-edge AI capabilities to developers worldwide. We focus on Developer Experience (DevEx), API platform infrastructure, and enabling our internal product teams to launch world-class APIs quickly and independently.

We are shifting gears from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers to simply maintain legacy endpoints or close Jira tickets. We hire Missionaries—builders who obsess over the Why before the How. You will contribute across the stack, shipping features that create delightful, frictionless experiences for both external developers and internal engineering teams.

 


YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Contribute to Developer Experience: You will build features that improve how developers discover, onboard to, and use DeepL APIs. This includes implementing self-service flows, onboarding experiences, and configuration interfaces that reduce friction and delight developers from their first API call

 - Build Platform Components: You will implement reusable components, contribute to documentation, and help maintain client libraries (SDKs) and starter templates that make it easier for customers and ISVs to build AI-enabled products on top of DeepL

 - Collaborate Across Teams: You will work closely with teammates across API Core and adjacent teams—including Enterprise, Core Text, Voice, and Customization—to deliver consistent, well-designed APIs. You will actively participate in code reviews, design discussions, and contribute to shared standards

 - Write Quality Code: You will write well-tested, production-ready code and contribute to monitoring, alerting, and reliability improvements. You will participate in incident response, learn from postmortems, and help the team continuously raise the bar on code quality and operational health

 


QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR

 - A Developer-Centric Mindset: You think about APIs from the perspective of the developer using them. You care about clear abstractions, helpful error messages, and good documentation—not just whether the endpoint returns a 200

 - Solid Backend Fundamentals with Full-Stack Curiosity: You have a good foundation in backend development, RESTful APIs, and server-side systems (using Go, Python, Java, C#, or similar). You're comfortable picking up frontend work when needed—whether that's contributing to a developer dashboard or a signup flow built in React/TypeScript

 - Ownership and Reliability: You take responsibility for what you ship. You write tests, monitor your code in production, and follow through when things go wrong. You're proactive about flagging issues and asking for help when you need it, and you treat each incident as an opportunity to learn

 - AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your output and reduce repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging—freeing up your focus for solving harder problems and growing your craft

 


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network

 - Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together

 - Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team's general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration

 - Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that's why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL's growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future

 - Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally

 - Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity

 - 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally

 - Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way

 

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

#LI-HK1




WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

jobs.title: Demand Generation & ABM Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT BRANDLIGHT

Brandlight is the leading enterprise AI visibility platform, built to help the world’s most iconic brands understand, manage, and optimize how they appear across AI-driven search, commerce, and advertising.

As AI rapidly becomes a trillion-dollar global marketing and distribution channel, Brandlight is defining the systems that decide how brands are surfaced, trusted, and chosen.

Join our team and help build the next generation of tools shaping the future of brand management in an AI-first world.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Demand Generation & ABM Lead at Brandlight, you will own our enterprise demand generation and account-based marketing motion, turning priority accounts, buying groups, account intelligence, and coordinated Sales and Marketing plays into qualified pipeline.

You will identify the accounts we need to win, understand the buying groups inside them, recognize the signals that indicate when and how to engage, and build programs that move those accounts from awareness to conversation to opportunity. This is not a lead-volume or MQL role. Success is qualified meetings, opportunities, pipeline progression, and sourced or influenced pipeline.

This is a hands-on role. You will work closely with Sales on account strategy and activation, with Growth Marketing on paid and scalable channels, with Field Marketing on executive and account programs, and with GTM Engineering on signals, enrichment, automation, and account intelligence.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own ABM strategy for Brandlight’s priority enterprise accounts, including account selection, segmentation, tiering, and prioritization.

 - Design and execute 1:1, 1-to-many, and scalable account-based programs based on account value, buying-group complexity, and stage.

 - Map buying groups across executives, champions, users, influencers, and decision-makers, and build multi-threaded engagement strategies.

 - Partner closely with Sales to create joint account plans, engagement strategies, next-best actions, and coordinated plays that move priority accounts into qualified meetings, opportunities, and pipeline.

 - Use intent signals, engagement, company initiatives, leadership changes, and other triggers to determine when and how to activate an account.

 - Develop account-specific messaging, offers, and campaign concepts with Product Marketing and Content.

 - Partner with Growth Marketing and Field Marketing to activate priority accounts through paid, digital, events, executive programs, and other relevant channels.

 - Work with GTM Engineering to turn account intelligence and signals into scalable workflows, alerts, and personalized actions.

 - Own measurement from target account through buying-group engagement, qualified meetings, opportunities, and pipeline; continuously test plays, messaging, offers, signals, and personalization, and use AI to improve research, campaign development, analysis, and execution.




REQUIREMENTS

 - 5+ years of experience in B2B demand generation, account-based marketing, enterprise marketing, or a similar role, ideally in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology.

 - Proven experience building and executing ABM programs for high-value enterprise accounts.

 - Strong understanding of account segmentation, tiering, buying groups, multi-threading, and complex enterprise buying journeys.

 - Experience designing 1:1 and 1:few ABM programs.

 - Proven experience partnering closely with Sales on account planning, activation, opportunity creation, and pipeline.

 - Strong understanding of account intelligence, intent signals, personalization, and trigger-based engagement.

 - Proven experience building programs tied to qualified meetings, opportunities, pipeline, or revenue.

 - Strong messaging, analytical, and commercial judgment.

 - AI-native in how you work, using AI to research, personalize, experiment, analyze, and execute, and comfortable building new demand motions without an established playbook.

 - Experience marketing to Fortune 1000 organizations, working in high-ACV, long-sales-cycle enterprise environments, or building signal-based or intent-driven ABM programs is a strong plus.




WHY JOIN US

jobs.title: Salary Controller
jobs.description:
AppsFlyer’s Finance Team is looking for an experienced Salary Controller  to join our payroll team and lead end-to-end payroll operations for a large, global workforce. The role is focused on Israeli payroll today, with room to grow into global payroll responsibilities over time. This role requires deep expertise across payroll processes, labor law, reporting to authorities, and the ability to handle complex cases in a fast-changing environment-while working closely with multiple stakeholders across the business.

This is a role for someone who wants to do more than execute: you'll be expected to bring AI and automation into how payroll is run, shaping new tools and processes as the function grows.

This is an outstanding opportunity to learn and grow within a fast-paced, dynamic global company, working with global standards and diverse stakeholders.

What you’ll do - Global standards:

• Own and analyze end-to-end payroll processes for 700+ employees, as part of the Payroll team, ensuring accuracy and compliance.

• Maintain and validate payroll master data across the employee lifecycle (onboarding, changes, terminations), ensuring data integrity across systems.

• Manage complex payroll cases (e.g., terminations, relocations, special benefits, corrections, retro payments, equity implications, leaves, garnishments, and exceptions).

• Lead payroll activities for month-end / quarter-end close, including reconciliations, variance analysis, and support for payroll journal entries and GL reporting.

• Partner closely with HR, Finance, Legal, and external vendors/consultants on payroll operations, compliance topics, and process improvements.

• Support internal/external audits and work with auditors to ensure documentation, controls, and payroll reports are audit-ready.

• Drive continuous improvement: build, document, and optimize payroll workflows, controls, and reporting in a fast-paced, changing environment.

What you bring (Must-have):

• 3 years of hands-on payroll experience from a large scale global company (preferably 700+ employees).

• Proven end-to-end payroll expertise, including calculations, benefits, deductions, reporting, and compliance.

• Solid understanding of payroll regulations and statutory reporting; ability to quickly learn and apply local labor and tax requirements (Israeli payroll knowledge is a strong advantage).

• Ability to manage high volume, tight deadlines, and frequent changes with high accuracy.

• Strong team player with a collaborative mindset, able to work effectively with multiple stakeholders (HR, Finance, Legal, external providers).

• High attention to detail, ownership, discretion, and integrity.

• Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, xlookups, reconciliations, data validation) and ability to analyze large datasets.

• Strong curiosity for technology and automation, with a genuine interest in applying AI tools to payroll operations and reporting.

• Fluent English (written and spoken) - an advantage.

Bonus Points:

• Hands-on experience with Hilan systems: Hilan Pro, Hilan NEXT, Hilanet (time & attendance).

• Experience with global payroll systems and/or supporting payroll activities outside Israel.

• Experience with NetSuite and HRIS platforms (Oracle - an advantage).

• Hands-on experience applying AI or automation tools to payroll, HR, or reporting workflows.

• Recommended by an AppsFlyer employee

jobs.title: Manager Engineering, Compliance Core
jobs.description:
The engineering team at Chainalysis is inspired by solving the hardest technical challenges and building products that establish trust in cryptocurrencies. We're a global organization that thrives on challenging work and doing it alongside exceptionally talented teammates. Our industry evolves rapidly, and our mission is to build a flexible, AI-driven platform that automates entity resolution, optimizes data labeling pipelines, and creates predictive models that identify illicit patterns before they escalate.

Compliance Core builds and operates the platform that customers rely on to evaluate blockchain risk in real time and continuously monitor activity across billions of transfers. Our systems screen transfers and withdrawals, reassess exposure as new information arrives, aggregate risk at the user and organization level, and power datasets used by other teams and customers.

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the team and shape the next generation of this platform. You’ll help decide what to evolve, rebuild, or retire, and sequence those changes while keeping our systems reliable for every customer. This role combines hands-on technical leadership with responsibility for the team’s growth, delivery, and operational health.

In this role, you’ll:

 - Lead the platform’s modernization. Set technical direction with the team, make architectural trade-offs, and turn complex changes into incremental migrations with clear milestones and safe rollouts.

 - Stay hands-on. Review code, write and challenge design documents, contribute prototypes or targeted fixes, and work directly with engineers to resolve difficult technical problems and production incidents.

 - Build and develop the team. Hire exceptional engineers, set clear expectations, provide candid feedback, manage performance, and support career growth. Create an environment where people can challenge ideas, take ownership, and do their best work.

 - Own delivery with your partners. Work with Product and upstream teams to turn customer needs and industry changes into an executable roadmap. Make priorities, dependencies, and trade-offs explicit, and follow through on commitments.

 - Make production operations sustainable. Set standards for reliability, latency, throughput, and data correctness. Improve observability, testing, incident response, and on-call practices so the platform can scale

We’re looking for candidates who have:

 - Experience building and operating high-throughput, event-driven distributed systems

 - Strong hands-on engineering judgment. You can work through implementation details, identify the real constraints in a design, and help the team make sound architectural decisions.

 - Experience managing engineers, including coaching, performance management, and career development, with evidence of improving both team effectiveness and engineering quality.

 - A track record of delivering complex technical initiatives across teams, breaking ambiguous problems into manageable steps, and balancing immediate customer needs with longer-term platform investment.

 - A collaborative leadership style: you welcome challenges, explain your decisions, and help engineers develop the judgment and ownership to lead work themselves.

 - Interest in blockchain and cryptocurrencies, or eagerness to learn.

Nice to have:

 - Experience modernizing or migrating critical production systems while maintaining service continuity.

 - Familiarity with JVM services in production.

 - Experience operating customer-facing systems with strict latency and availability requirements.

 - Background in compliance, payments, fraud, or another regulated domain.

 - Blockchain protocol knowledge.
   

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.



About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.



You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here https://go.chainalysis.com/rs/503-FAP-074/images/Interview%20Accommodations%20Request.pdf. We can’t wait to meet you.

jobs.description:
WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON

Your main challenge

As a Graphic Designer within Gameloft’s Creative Agency Team (CAT), you will help shape how Gameloft presents itself to players, candidates and employees around the world.

Reporting to the CAT Lead Artist, you will turn communication needs into engaging visual experiences across corporate branding, employer branding, social media, events, merchandise and internal communications, collaborating with teams across Gameloft’s international studios.

What it means on a daily basis

• Create high-quality visual assets for Gameloft’s global corporate and employer brand.
• Own creative projects from initial brief and concept through to final delivery.
• Develop visual concepts, mood boards and design systems for global and local communication campaigns.
• Design and adapt assets across social media, digital, print, presentations, events, merchandise and environmental graphics.
• Apply strong typography, composition, layout, illustration and retouching skills to your work.
• Collaborate with Global Communications, Social Media, Marketing, HR and other teams across our international studios.
• Translate briefs and communication objectives into clear and compelling visual solutions.
• Manage several projects and stakeholders simultaneously while keeping quality and deadlines on track.
• Apply and help evolve Gameloft’s global brand guidelines, templates and reusable design systems.
• Bring fresh ideas to the team and explore new creative tools, trends and AI-assisted workflows where relevant.

What success will look like

Within your first months, you will be able to independently take projects from brief to delivery while producing polished work that is consistent with Gameloft’s visual identity.

You will become a trusted creative partner for our global teams, contributing ideas rather than simply executing briefs, while managing feedback, priorities and deadlines effectively.

Over time, you will also help us improve our visual standards, templates, workflows and design systems across the company.

Who you would be working with

You will report to the CAT Lead Artist and work closely with Gameloft’s Global Communications, Social Media, Marketing, HR and studio communication teams, collaborating with colleagues across Europe, North America, Southeast Asia and Australia.

Your recruitment journey

• Recruiter interview
• Hiring team interview
• Design test
• Final interview

Where this role can take you

You will have the opportunity to contribute to high-visibility international projects and develop your expertise across branding, visual communication and creative direction while working with teams across Gameloft’s global network.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

• Strong graphic design and visual communication skills, with excellent typography, composition and layout fundamentals.
• Professional experience using Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign.
• Ability to independently manage the creative process from concept to final delivery.
• Ability to translate a creative brief into effective visual solutions.
• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
• Fluency in English, with strong communication skills in an international environment.
• An online portfolio showcasing relevant graphic design work. Please include it with your application.

WHO YOU ARE

• Creative and curious, with a strong eye for detail.
• Comfortable presenting ideas, receiving feedback and collaborating with different stakeholders.
• Proactive and able to take ownership of your projects.
• Open to experimenting with new creative tools, workflows and AI-assisted production techniques.
• Comfortable working with multicultural teams across different countries and time zones.

Nice to have

• Employer branding or corporate branding experience.
• Experience working in an international or multicultural organization.
• Motion design skills, particularly After Effects.
• Illustration skills.
• Figma experience.
• Experience designing merchandise, environmental graphics or event branding.
• Interest in the video game industry.

Why Join the World of Gameloft?

• Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing!
• Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers!
• Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries & cultures!
• Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace!
• Or, just because you’re looking for a great place to work!

Benefits:

• Private medical health insurance
• Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card
• Free language courses
• Learning bootcamps and platforms (such as O'Reilly and GDC Vault)
• Birthday day off + option to work a shortened schedule on three days.
• Flexible work-from-home hybrid model
• Career-development opportunities.
• Excellent local working conditions (quality of offices, geographical location of office in the centre of Barcelona).
• ... and Thursday afterwork beers!

We can’t wait to find our next great talent!

Join our team, recently recognized in Forbes' top 100 companies to work for! We're gamers from all walks of life, united in creating a culture of inclusivity. Partnering with organizations like COGAM, we ensure a safe workplace for everyone, regardless of background or gaming preference. Whether you're a casual or hardcore gamer on any platform (we're cross-platform now!), we want you to feel like you belong. Be part of shaping the gaming industry with us!

jobs.title: Service Desk Analyst
jobs.description:
At a glance

Location: Cambridge

In-office expectation: 5 days per week

Employment type: Permanent

Salary: £28,000 to £35,000



Why this role exists

Everyone at Redgate relies on IT that just works, and when it doesn't, they rely on fast, friendly support to put things right. This role exists to be the first point of contact for IT issues across our offices, resolving what you can at first line and making sure everything else reaches the right team quickly.



About Redgate

Redgate brings together people who want to do their best work in an environment built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.

We build solutions that help data professionals securely manage the data and databases that their organizations depend on, a space that's only becoming more critical as systems scale, data regulations increase, and AI adoption accelerates.



AI at Redgate

By 2028, Redgate will operate as an expert-plus-agent company, domain experts amplified by AI, delivering customer value at a pace our peers can't match.

AI handles the heavy lifting. Our people control the judgement. Everyone at Redgate works with Claude, giving you access to the best AI tools from day one.



Why join our Technical Operations team?

There's real scope to grow your skills and impact, with clear pathways and support.

We value sustainable delivery, good ways of working and time to improve how we build.



About the role

You'll be the first point of contact for anyone at Redgate with an IT question or issue, whether they're in our Cambridge office or one of our offices around the world. It's a role where your instincts and problem solving make a real difference, whether that's spotting a trend before it becomes a bigger issue or finding a quick way to unblock someone.

• You'll triage, log, and resolve incidents and requests, escalating to the Service Desk Engineers, Infrastructure team, or Security when needed

• You'll help onboard new starters, configure end user devices, and keep our IT equipment and documentation up to date

• You'll work closely with the wider Technical Operations team, sharing what you learn and helping improve how we support the business

• You'll have the chance to spot patterns and trends in the issues you see, and use that insight to help prevent problems before they happen



What makes you a great fit

• Experience using Microsoft operating systems and applications, including M365 productivity tools such as Word and Excel

• Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot creatively and pay close attention to detail

• Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to a non-technical audience

• Ability to manage multiple tasks at once and stay effective under pressure

• A genuine interest in learning and using new technology, and confidence suggesting ideas to improve how we work

What we offer

Salary range: £28,000 to £35,000

• Monthly wellbeing allowance and generous paid time off

• Genuine investment in learning, development, and career progression

• Private health insurance

You can read more about our full benefits here https://www.redgate.com/



What happens next?

Your application will be reviewed by a person. We don't use AI or automated tools to assess applications, and every profile is read by one of our Talent Partners.

You'll hear back within a few days. Whether it's a next step or a no, we aim to respond promptly so you're not left wondering.

Our interview process is straightforward and consistent. You'll find more detail on our typical hiring process below, so you know what's coming and why.



Belonging at Redgate

We believe that people do their best work in an environment built on respect, fairness, and trust, and that diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes. Redgate is an equal opportunity employer, and we make hiring decisions based on skill, potential, and alignment with our values.

You can read more about how we approach belonging and inclusion at Redgate on our Belonging at Redgate page https://www.redgate.com/

jobs.title: Environmental Scientist / Industrial Hygienist
jobs.description:
J.S. Held is seeking an experienced and motivated Environmental Scientist II to join our Industrial Hygiene & Built Environment practice in Massachusetts. This role offers the opportunity to support a diverse portfolio of projects across the Northeast, including commercial, healthcare, higher education, municipal, and industrial facilities.

The successful candidate will lead and perform environmental assessments, hazardous building material investigations, indoor air quality evaluations, and remediation oversight while partnering closely with industrial hygienists, project managers, and clients. This position is ideal for a consultant who enjoys a balance of fieldwork, technical problem-solving, client interaction, and project coordination.

Job Responsibilities

• Conduct environmental investigations and hazardous building material assessments involving asbestos, lead-based paint, mold, and other environmental concerns.
• Perform air, bulk, wipe, and surface sampling in accordance with federal and state regulations, project specifications, and industry best practices.
• Support and independently execute indoor air quality (IAQ) assessments, moisture intrusion investigations, and building condition evaluations.
• Provide on-site oversight of abatement, remediation, and demolition projects, including final visual inspections and clearance sampling.
• Prepare detailed technical reports, field documentation, and regulatory-compliant project deliverables.
• Coordinate laboratory analysis, review analytical results, and assist in interpreting findings for clients and project teams.
• Ensure compliance with applicable OSHA, EPA, AHERA, Massachusetts DEP, and local regulatory requirements.
• Maintain project schedules, manage multiple assignments simultaneously, and communicate project updates to managers and clients.
• Support proposal efforts, client relationship development, and mentoring of junior staff as experience level permits.
• Participate in health and safety planning and promote a strong safety culture across all project activities.

Required

• Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Industrial Hygiene, Occupational Health, Environmental Engineering, Geology, or a related discipline.
• 3+ years of experience in environmental consulting, industrial hygiene, hazardous building materials, or related environmental field services.
• Demonstrated experience conducting asbestos, lead, and mold inspections and sampling.
• Strong understanding of environmental regulations and industry sampling methodologies.
• Experience preparing technical reports and maintaining defensible project documentation.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to manage field assignments independently and travel throughout Massachusetts and the broader Northeast region as needed.
• Valid driver's license with a satisfactory driving record.

Preferred

• Massachusetts Asbestos Inspector certification.
• Massachusetts Asbestos Project Monitor certification.
• Lead Inspector/Risk Assessor and/or Lead Sampling Technician certification.
• NIOSH 582 Microscopy Training.
• OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER certification.
• Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) track or interest in pursuing professional certifications.
• Experience supporting healthcare, higher education, life sciences, commercial real estate, or municipal clients.

Some of the Benefits We Have Include

jobs.title: Mitarbeiter:in für digitale Belegprüfung (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
SKALAR – Wir bauen die digitale Steuerkanzlei der Zukunft

Radikal einfach. Voll digital. 100% mandantenfokussiert.

Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfacher, schneller und transparenter für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam zugleich.

Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen, langen Wartezeiten und intransparenter Kommunikation kämpfen, bauen wir ein völlig neues Erlebnis - digital, proaktiv, KI-gestützt. Mit automatisierten Prozessen im Hintergrund und digitalen Schnittstellen zum Mandanten laufen repetitive Aufgaben weitgehend von selbst - damit du Zeit hast für das, was wirklich zählt: anspruchsvolle Beratung, Sonderfälle und strategische Mandantenfragen.

Der Unterschied zu anderen "Digitalkanzleien": Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Du gestaltest direkt mit, was sie bauen - und damit, wie KI-gestützte Steuerberatung in dieser Branche überhaupt aussehen wird. Dein Steuerwissen prägt das Produkt, nicht nur dessen Anwendung.

Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €. Mit dir gemeinsam möchten wir eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands aufbauen.


Die Rolle in einem Satz

Du prüfst die Belege und Buchungsdaten unserer Mandanten, klärst Unstimmigkeiten direkt mit ihnen und sorgst dafür, dass unser Steuer-Team auf einer sauberen Datenbasis arbeitet.

Dazu arbeitest du Hand in Hand mit unserer KI: Du kontrollierst, was sie vorschlägt, übernimmst die Fälle, an die sie noch nicht herankommt, und entwickelst sie mit jedem Fall weiter.

 

Eine steuerfachliche Ausbildung brauchst du dafür nicht.

 


DEINE AUFGABEN

1. Du bist die Kontrollinstanz zwischen Daten und Automatisierung

 - Unsere KI liest Belege aus, ordnet sie Bankumsätzen zu und schlägt die Verarbeitung vor. Du prüfst diese Vorschläge: Rechnungsangaben, Steuerausweis, Zeitraum, Zuordnung zum Mandanten.

 - Du bestätigst, korrigierst oder verwirfst.

 - Du erkennst, wo die Erkennung systematisch danebenliegt: bestimmte Belegtypen, Lieferanten, Fremdwährungen, Formate.

 - Du behältst die Schnittstellen im Blick und meldest, wenn eine Anbindung ausfällt oder dieselben Umsätze zweimal liefert.

2. Du übernimmst, was die KI noch nicht kann

 - Unklare Zahlungspartner, widersprüchliche Zuordnungen, Sonderfälle ohne Vorlage – alles, was sich nicht automatisch auflöst, landet bei dir.

 - Du recherchierst den Sachverhalt und entscheidest ihn im Rahmen unserer Prüfkriterien; alles, was eine steuerliche Beurteilung erfordert, geht an einen Berufsträger.

 - Du dokumentierst deine Lösung so, dass sie beim nächsten Mal automatisierbar ist.

Je besser die Automatisierung wird, desto anspruchsvoller werden die Fälle, die bei dir landen. Die Rolle wird dadurch nicht kleiner, sondern fachlicher.

3. Du klärst mit den Mandanten

 - Du forderst fehlende Belege an – schriftlich, konkret und mit Frist – und verfolgst offene Punkte bis zur Erledigung nach, damit die BWA bis zum 15. steht.

 - Du erklärst verständlich, warum ein Beleg nicht ausreicht und was du stattdessen brauchst.

4. Du machst die KI besser

 - Mit dem Experten-Wissen, das du dir aufbaust, wirst du zum wichtigen Input-Geber für unsere Produkt-Teams.

 - Aus deinen Korrekturen und den Mustern, die du erkennst, werden Regeln, Prompts und Modellanpassungen – die entwickelst du gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design.

 - Du testest, was gebaut wurde, an echten Fällen und entscheidest mit, was als Nächstes automatisiert wird.

 


DEIN PROFIL


MUST-HAVE

 - Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium – die Richtung ist zweitrangig. Quereinsteiger:innen sind ausdrücklich willkommen.

 - Analytisches Denken: Du erkennst Muster und Abweichungen in Daten, ziehst aus Einzelfällen die richtigen Schlüsse und kannst begründen, warum etwas nicht stimmt.

 - Verlässliche Qualität bei hoher Fallzahl: Du arbeitest gründlich, auch wenn die KI in den meisten Fällen richtig liegt – gerade dann fallen die Ausnahmen leicht durchs Raster.

 - Interesse an KI und Automatisierung: Du willst verstehen, warum ein System etwas vorschlägt, und nicht nur, was es vorschlägt.

 - Sicherer Umgang mit Excel/Google Sheets und digitalen Tools; Lust, dich in neue Software schnell einzuarbeiten.

 - Klare, freundliche schriftliche Kommunikation auf Deutsch (C1/C2) – der Mandantenkontakt läuft überwiegend schriftlich.

 - Eigenständigkeit und Verbindlichkeit: Remote-Arbeit funktioniert nur, wenn Zusagen halten.

 - Der erkennbare Wille, sich in Richtung Führung oder Mandantenverantwortung weiterzuentwickeln.

Nice-to-have

 - Kaufmännisches Verständnis: Du weißt, wie ein Geschäftsvorfall von der Rechnung bis zur Zahlung läuft.

 - Erste Berührung mit Buchhaltung, Rechnungswesen, DATEV oder kaufmännischer Sachbearbeitung.

 - Erfahrung aus einem Umfeld mit hohem Datenvolumen (Operations, Backoffice, Support, Fulfillment, Payment).

Kanzleierfahrung und Programmierkenntnisse erwarten wir nicht.

 


WAS WIR BIETEN

🚀 Deine Verbesserungsvorschläge werden gebaut – nicht abgeheftet. Unser Anspruch: Ein klar beschriebener, umsetzbarer Vorschlag ist innerhalb von acht Arbeitsstunden live. Das geht, weil Engineering, Design und Fachteam bei uns am selben Tisch sitzen.

🤖 Du arbeitest an der Grenze dessen, was Automatisierung in der Steuerberatung kann – und verschiebst sie. Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen, moderne Hardware.

🏡 Vollständig remote möglich. Büro in München im Herzen der Stadt, wenn du willst – Pflicht ist es nicht.

🎓 Weiterbildung, fachlich und finanziell unterstützt – etwa zum/zur Steuerfachangestellten, Steuerfachwirt:in oder Bilanzbuchhalter:in.

🤝 Steile Lernkurve mit Gründern und Tech-Team. Kurze Wege, direktes Sparring, Entscheidungen ohne Hierarchieschleifen.

 

Bereit, Steuerberatung neu zu definieren?

Werde Teil von Skalar — und gestalte mit uns das modernste Mandantenerlebnis Deutschlands.

Who we are

What we do

With a global team of over 2,000 professionals, we work side-by-side with our customers to solve real problems with lasting impact. Companies trust RELEX to increase product availability, boost sales, deliver actionable insights, improve sustainability, and drive profitable growth. What we offer in return

jobs.description:

ABOUT XYZ REALITY

──────────────────────────────

XYZ Reality are the creators of the world's first and only engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution, purpose built for the construction industry. Not only have we created this holographic technology, that sits within The Atom — a smart, site-safe headset/hardhat — but we implement it on projects, utilising the power of AR to ensure that all schemes are completed in line with delivery timescales and budgets.



XYZ has grown to over 100 staff across the UK, US & Europe and is working with Mission Critical organisations & construction companies to successfully deliver major projects.



THE ROLE

The VDC Manager is part of the Client Operations team, sitting within the Project Controls function and working closely with the BIM team.



You will be responsible for driving the effective integration of Virtual Design and Construction (VDC) methodologies, BIM processes, and model-based workflows across projects — working closely with Deployment, Cost, Customer Success, and Technology teams to ensure BIM data and processes effectively support project delivery.



The role requires direct engagement with clients, contractors, and designers, and combines strong technical expertise in BIM/VDC and model management with the leadership and communication skills to set standards, mentor the team, and influence how AR technology is integrated across construction projects.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills — comfortable presenting technical concepts to non-technical audiences including clients and senior leadership.

🪙 Biannual salary reviews

jobs.title: Game Cinematic Artist Intern
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON

Your main challenge

As a Game Cinematic Artist Intern, you will join our team in Barcelona and learn how cinematic sequences are created and implemented directly inside a real-time game engine.

Working alongside our artists and game team, you will help create compelling camera shots and sequences for our games, from race introductions and menu sequences to in-game cinematics. You will develop your eye for framing, composition and visual storytelling while gaining hands-on experience with our cinematic tools and pipelines.

What it means on a daily basis

• Create and adapt 3D camera shots and cinematic sequences inside our real-time game engine, including race intros, menu sequences and in-game cinematics.
• Work with 3D characters, vehicles and other game assets, positioning them within scenes and finding the best framing and composition.
• Learn and work with our existing real-time cinematic tools and pipelines, maintaining and updating sequences as the game evolves.
• Review and test your work directly in-game, identifying visual or technical issues and making the necessary adjustments.
• Collaborate with the game and art teams, responding to feedback and supporting new cinematic needs throughout production.

WHAT SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

In your first 3 months, you will become familiar with our game engine, cinematic pipeline and existing camera sequences, progressively contributing your own shots with guidance from the team.

By 6 months, you will be comfortable creating and adapting camera sequences for different areas of the game, testing your work and incorporating feedback with increasing autonomy.

As you progress, you will develop a stronger understanding of real-time cinematics and visual storytelling while contributing polished camera work that enhances the presentation of our games.

WHO YOU WOULD BE WORKING WITH

You will work closely with our Art and Game teams in Barcelona, collaborating with the people responsible for the characters, environments and game content featured in your cinematic sequences.

You will receive guidance from experienced team members while gradually taking more ownership of your work as you become familiar with our tools and pipelines.

YOUR RECRUITMENT JOURNEY

• Recruiter interview
• Hiring team interview
• Portfolio/showreel review
• Test

WHERE THIS ROLE CAN TAKE YOU

This internship will give you practical experience in real-time cinematics within a professional game development environment, developing transferable skills in camera work, composition, 3D workflows and visual storytelling.

You will also gain exposure to how Art and Game teams collaborate to take cinematic content from an initial idea to its final implementation in-game.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

• Basic understanding of 3D environments and workflows, including navigating scenes and manipulating 3D objects.
• Understanding of camera composition, framing and visual storytelling in a 3D environment.
• Familiarity with at least one real-time game engine, such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
• Ability to understand how positioning, framing and camera movement can help present 3D characters, vehicles and environments effectively.
• Good attention to both visual and technical details.
• Good level of English.
• Ability to sign an internship agreement with a school or university.

WHO YOU ARE

• Curious about video games, film and visual storytelling.
• Eager to learn new tools, workflows and technical pipelines.
• Creative, with a good eye for composition and presentation.
• Comfortable receiving feedback and iterating on your work.
• Organized and able to work towards deadlines.
• Proactive while knowing when to ask the team for guidance.
• Detail-oriented and willing to test and review your own work.

Why Join the World of Gameloft?

• Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing!
• Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers!
• Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries & cultures!
• Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace!
• Or, just because you’re looking for a great place to work!

Benefits:

• Internship agreement for 6 months
• Flexible schedule adapted to your student needs
• Flexible work from home hybrid model
• An exceptional, dynamic, demanding and motivating working environment within a fast-growing company
• Free coffee in the office
• Excellent local working conditions (quality of offices, geographical location of office in the centre of Barcelona)
• ... and Thursday afterwork beers!

We can’t wait to find our next great talent!

Join our team, recently recognized in Forbes' top 100 companies to work for! We're gamers from all walks of life, united in creating a culture of inclusivity. Partnering with organizations like COGAM, we ensure a safe workplace for everyone, regardless of background or gaming preference. Whether you're a casual or hardcore gamer on any platform (we're cross-platform now!), we want you to feel like you belong. Be part of shaping the gaming industry with us!

Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted and your CV will be saved in our files for a period of 6 months.

Want to know more? Please visit our Website: www.gameloft.com

If the offer interests you, Join the Game!

jobs.title: Registration Representative
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Registration Representative to handle user registration with the EGX independently, with minimal supervision.

The role includes registering users end-to-end, running daily operational scripts, using SQL to pull and review data.

It also involves coordinating with the EGX to resolve issues, working with other teams, along with identifying the root causes of issues.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Register users with EGX, end to end

• Write and edit SQL queries to pull and review data

• Prepare and run daily operational scripts (ID downloads, bookings, etc.)

• Review your own work and track each case.

• Coordinate with the EGX and other teams to resolve issues




WHAT YOU’LL NEED

• Strong data entry accuracy

• Good working knowledge of Google Sheets (functions, filters)

• High attention to detail, especially with documentation and data accuracy

• Strong sense of ownership — able to work with minimal supervision.

• Confident communication skills.

• Comfortable coordinating with other teams/departments

• Analytical mindset — able to trace an issue back to its root cause




NICE TO HAVE

 - Support Communication skills — useful for handling users chats directly and helping resolve their issues when needed.

 - Working knowledge of SQL (able to write and edit queries independently)

 
 


WHO ARE WE?

Thndr was founded on a bold dream to democratize access to investing through smart tech and human-centric design. This is simply our way of saying we give anyone with a smartphone the simple and easy access they need to preserve and grow their wealth. At the same time, we’re shaping the future of investing while actively driving the economies we serve by promoting local investment products.

History has shown that investing is the single greatest way to build long-term wealth, but before Thndr, only a very small percentage of people had access to it due to:

 - High barriers to entry — In the form of excessive minimum account balances, complex, outdated onboarding, and low financial literacy.

 - Irrelevant experience — Catered toward expert traders and financial specialists, therefore alienating the majority of the population.

 - Fragmented offering — Investment products were not gathered in a single, intuitive outlet.

We don't just talk about change, we deliver it. Here's a glimpse into our impact so far:

 - 5.5 million app downloads

 - EGP 1B+ average daily traded value across 2025

 - #1 digital investing platform in Egypt for the third consecutive year

 - 76% of users are first-time investors

 - 40% of our users come from outside of capital cities and have previously had limited access to financial institutions

Building on the success of our core platform, we are continuing to change culture and break down barriers by launching Rumble, the subscription-based investment recommendations platform.

Rumble was born with the vision to empower everyday individuals to build wealth confidently and intelligently through access to timely and in-depth advice from the industry’s top experts.

Going beyond traditional investment advice, it offers long and short-term investment recommendations and financial content through engaging articles and videos that guide users on their financial journey and maximize their returns.

At Thndr, we're looking for people driven by our mission to help us democratize investing across the MENA region.

jobs.title: Spezialist:in für digitale Belegprüfung (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
SKALAR – Wir bauen die digitale Steuerkanzlei der Zukunft

Radikal einfach. Voll digital. 100% mandantenfokussiert.

Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfacher, schneller und transparenter für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam zugleich.

Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen, langen Wartezeiten und intransparenter Kommunikation kämpfen, bauen wir ein völlig neues Erlebnis - digital, proaktiv, KI-gestützt. Mit automatisierten Prozessen im Hintergrund und digitalen Schnittstellen zum Mandanten laufen repetitive Aufgaben weitgehend von selbst - damit du Zeit hast für das, was wirklich zählt: anspruchsvolle Beratung, Sonderfälle und strategische Mandantenfragen.

Der Unterschied zu anderen "Digitalkanzleien": Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Du gestaltest direkt mit, was sie bauen - und damit, wie KI-gestützte Steuerberatung in dieser Branche überhaupt aussehen wird. Dein Steuerwissen prägt das Produkt, nicht nur dessen Anwendung.

Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €. Mit dir gemeinsam möchten wir eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands aufbauen.



Die Rolle in einem Satz

Du prüfst die Belege und Buchungsdaten unserer Mandanten, klärst Unstimmigkeiten direkt mit ihnen und sorgst dafür, dass unser Steuer-Team auf einer sauberen Datenbasis arbeitet.

Dazu arbeitest du Hand in Hand mit unserer KI: Du kontrollierst, was sie vorschlägt, übernimmst die Fälle, an die sie noch nicht herankommt, und entwickelst sie mit jedem Fall weiter.

 

Eine steuerfachliche Ausbildung brauchst du dafür nicht.

 


DEINE AUFGABEN

1. Du bist die Kontrollinstanz zwischen Daten und Automatisierung

 - Unsere KI liest Belege aus, ordnet sie Bankumsätzen zu und schlägt die Verarbeitung vor. Du prüfst diese Vorschläge: Rechnungsangaben, Steuerausweis, Zeitraum, Zuordnung zum Mandanten.

 - Du bestätigst, korrigierst oder verwirfst.

 - Du erkennst, wo die Erkennung systematisch danebenliegt: bestimmte Belegtypen, Lieferanten, Fremdwährungen, Formate.

 - Du behältst die Schnittstellen im Blick und meldest, wenn eine Anbindung ausfällt oder dieselben Umsätze zweimal liefert.

2. Du übernimmst, was die KI noch nicht kann

 - Unklare Zahlungspartner, widersprüchliche Zuordnungen, Sonderfälle ohne Vorlage – alles, was sich nicht automatisch auflöst, landet bei dir.

 - Du recherchierst den Sachverhalt und entscheidest ihn im Rahmen unserer Prüfkriterien; alles, was eine steuerliche Beurteilung erfordert, geht an einen Berufsträger.

 - Du dokumentierst deine Lösung so, dass sie beim nächsten Mal automatisierbar ist.

Je besser die Automatisierung wird, desto anspruchsvoller werden die Fälle, die bei dir landen. Die Rolle wird dadurch nicht kleiner, sondern fachlicher.

3. Du klärst mit den Mandanten

 - Du forderst fehlende Belege an – schriftlich, konkret und mit Frist – und verfolgst offene Punkte bis zur Erledigung nach, damit die BWA bis zum 15. steht.

 - Du erklärst verständlich, warum ein Beleg nicht ausreicht und was du stattdessen brauchst.

4. Du machst die KI besser

 - Mit dem Experten-Wissen, das du dir aufbaust, wirst du zum wichtigen Input-Geber für unsere Produkt-Teams.

 - Aus deinen Korrekturen und den Mustern, die du erkennst, werden Regeln, Prompts und Modellanpassungen – die entwickelst du gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design.

 - Du testest, was gebaut wurde, an echten Fällen und entscheidest mit, was als Nächstes automatisiert wird.




DEIN PROFIL


MUST-HAVE

 - Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium – die Richtung ist zweitrangig. Quereinsteiger:innen sind ausdrücklich willkommen.

 - Analytisches Denken: Du erkennst Muster und Abweichungen in Daten, ziehst aus Einzelfällen die richtigen Schlüsse und kannst begründen, warum etwas nicht stimmt.

 - Verlässliche Qualität bei hoher Fallzahl: Du arbeitest gründlich, auch wenn die KI in den meisten Fällen richtig liegt – gerade dann fallen die Ausnahmen leicht durchs Raster.

 - Interesse an KI und Automatisierung: Du willst verstehen, warum ein System etwas vorschlägt, und nicht nur, was es vorschlägt.

 - Sicherer Umgang mit Excel/Google Sheets und digitalen Tools; Lust, dich in neue Software schnell einzuarbeiten.

 - Klare, freundliche schriftliche Kommunikation auf Deutsch (C1/C2) – der Mandantenkontakt läuft überwiegend schriftlich.

 - Eigenständigkeit und Verbindlichkeit: Remote-Arbeit funktioniert nur, wenn Zusagen halten.

 - Der erkennbare Wille, sich in Richtung Führung oder Mandantenverantwortung weiterzuentwickeln.

Nice-to-have

 - Kaufmännisches Verständnis: Du weißt, wie ein Geschäftsvorfall von der Rechnung bis zur Zahlung läuft.

 - Erste Berührung mit Buchhaltung, Rechnungswesen, DATEV oder kaufmännischer Sachbearbeitung.

 - Erfahrung aus einem Umfeld mit hohem Datenvolumen (Operations, Backoffice, Support, Fulfillment, Payment).

Kanzleierfahrung und Programmierkenntnisse erwarten wir nicht.




WAS WIR BIETEN

🚀 Deine Verbesserungsvorschläge werden gebaut – nicht abgeheftet. Unser Anspruch: Ein klar beschriebener, umsetzbarer Vorschlag ist innerhalb von acht Arbeitsstunden live. Das geht, weil Engineering, Design und Fachteam bei uns am selben Tisch sitzen.

🤖 Du arbeitest an der Grenze dessen, was Automatisierung in der Steuerberatung kann – und verschiebst sie. Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen, moderne Hardware.

🏡 Vollständig remote möglich. Büro in München im Herzen der Stadt, wenn du willst – Pflicht ist es nicht.

🎓 Weiterbildung, fachlich und finanziell unterstützt – etwa zum/zur Steuerfachangestellten, Steuerfachwirt:in oder Bilanzbuchhalter:in.

🤝 Steile Lernkurve mit Gründern und Tech-Team. Kurze Wege, direktes Sparring, Entscheidungen ohne Hierarchieschleifen.



Bereit, Steuerberatung neu zu definieren?

Werde Teil von Skalar — und gestalte mit uns das modernste Mandantenerlebnis Deutschlands.

jobs.description:

This role gives recent ALX graduates hands-on experience in customer operations, structured problem-solving, and scalable support systems. You will learn how to deliver a high-quality, human support experience while mastering the operational discipline that powers it behind the scenes.

About ALX Africa

ALX Africa, a non-profit organisation under the ALX Foundation, is dedicated to unlocking the potential of Africa's digital future. Formerly part of Sand Tech Holdings, we've embarked on an independent journey to provide world-class tech skills training and career acceleration programmes. Our mission is to bridge the digital divide, upskill and re-skill talent, and create a generation of innovative leaders. By 2030, we aim to empower 2 million Africans to secure sustainable tech careers.

With hubs in 8 cities across Africa and counting, we provide safe access to quality learning and a dedicated network of expert instructors. Our innovative programmes equip learners with the practical skills and knowledge needed to succeed in today's rapidly evolving tech industry. Through a combination of rigorous coursework, industry partnerships, and hands-on projects, we prepare our students for in-demand roles in software engineering, data science, and cybersecurity.

We achieve this by:

• Providing young professionals with access to the most in-demand tech skills that will power the future.

• Empowering the next generation of technology innovators, entrepreneurs, and business leaders through challenging, real-world coursework.

• Building a lifelong, impactful community of tech professionals that support them at all stages of their career journey.

Our impact thus far:

• 347k+ graduates since 2020

• 257k youth in work

• 31k youth starting own ventures

• 60k youth in jobs created by entrepreneurs

Visit our website www.alxafrica.com to learn more about our digital revolution.

Role Summary

ALX Africa is looking for a French-speaking Customer Support Freelancer. Our support agents are the frontline of our Customer Support team. You will manage asynchronous email tickets and learner inquiries from intake to resolution, following structured workflows and quality standards. You will deliver quality customer service to our learners in French programmes.

This is a learning-focused role. You will develop:

• Clear, human-written communication

• Strong process discipline

• Structured troubleshooting fundamentals

• Confidence in handling high-volume environments

• The ability to recognise patterns and escalate effectively

This role requires someone who speaks French and English fluently, thrives in structured systems, enjoys pattern spotting, and takes real pride in delivering a human, personal, high-quality support experience at scale.

Specific Responsibilities

• Own async email tickets and backlog items from intake to resolution.

• Respond to learners with clarity, warmth, and precision.

• Follow documented workflows and escalation guidelines consistently.

• Ensure tickets are properly tagged, categorised, and documented.

• Escalate technical or high-impact issues to senior team members when needed.

• Contribute to knowledge base updates under guidance.

• Participate in weekly trend reviews and learn how to interpret support data.

• Spot patterns in recurring issues and raise them early, backed by clear data and insights.

• Support social media escalations in collaboration with the broader team.

• Maintain high QA standards across volume and complexity.

• Strengthen the customer journey by ensuring our support experience is predictable, trustworthy, and human.

Skill Requirements - Essential

• Fluent in written and spoken French and English. Being based in a French-speaking country is an added advantage.

• Must have graduated from an ALX Program within the past 12 months.

• Excellent written communication with the ability to make complex things simple and human.

• Strong attention to detail and consistency.

• Fast learner with a bias toward action and continuous improvement.

• Comfortable working within structured systems and documented workflows.

• Willingness to receive feedback and improve quickly.

• Self-driven and reliable in a remote work environment.

• Comfortable using ticketing tools such as Freshdesk, Zendesk, Hubspot, or similar platforms (or able to learn quickly).

Skill Requirements - Preferable

• Internship or project experience in customer support, operations, or tech.

• Exposure to knowledge base documentation or structured writing.

• Basic understanding of how online platforms or tech systems operate.

• Experience working cross-functionally with product, engineering, or community teams.

Person Specification/Attributes

• Courage: Willingness to speak up, challenge the status quo, and embrace new challenges.

• Humility: Openness to learning, seeking help when needed, and a focus on serving others.

• Adventure: A passion for setting ambitious goals, tackling difficult tasks, and finding joy in the journey.

• Initiative: Proactive problem-solving, a sense of ownership, and a willingness to go above and beyond.

• Resilience: The ability to bounce back from setbacks, persevere through challenges, and emerge stronger.

• Customer-obsessed and able to make customers feel genuinely cared for.

• Systems-minded with a natural instinct for process, structure, and clarity.

• Proactive, takes initiative, and executes without waiting for direction.

• Calm and grounded during high-volume or complex situations.

• Analytical, methodical, and thoughtful.

• Collaborative, empathetic, and able to communicate with technical and non-technical teammates.

• Adaptable and energised by fast-moving environments.

Employment Type

This role is a freelancer position

Preferred Time Zones

UTC-1 to UTC+3 preferred

Due to the considerable amount of virtual working and interaction with colleagues and customers in different physical locations internationally, it is essential that the successful applicant has the drive and ethic to succeed working in small teams physically but in larger efforts virtually. Self-drive to communicate constantly using web collaboration and video conferencing is essential.

jobs.title: React Engineer — xCharts
jobs.description:
You will help form the xCharts team, build ambitious and complex new features, work on strategic problems, and help grow adoption.




DETAILS OF THE ROLE

 - Location: Remote (strong preference for UTC-6 to UTC+5).

 - Type of work: Full-time (contractor or employee depending on circumstances https://mui-org.notion.site/Hiring-FAQ-64763b756ae44c37b47b081f98915501#494af1f358794028beb4b7697b5d3102).

 - Level: IC4 or above https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1dDdPD-flNXlgZ0E3ZxVvCDx27RFuhVWJrcfcjNu_I8k/edit#gid=0.

 - We're a remote company, we prefer asynchronous communication over meetings.




THE COMPANY

MUI's story began in 2014 with Material UI, the most successful React implementation of Google's Material Design. Today, Material UI stands as one of the most popular open-source libraries on GitHub and has paved the way for the fully-fledged startup known as MUI (founded in 2019), which now boasts an ever-expanding ecosystem of React UI products.

We're a company of 35+ people as of early 2024, and we're growing.





THE PRODUCTS

MUI is best known for our flagship product, Material UI—but this is just one of three core component libraries we maintain. Base UI is our headless component library, and Pigment CSS is a zero-runtime CSS-in-JS styling engine. We also host Design Kits and pre-built Templates.

Beyond the core libraries, MUI X offers advanced components like the Data Grid, Date and Time Pickers, and Charts, for more complex user interactions and data visualization needs.

We're also making ambitious moves to incorporate our full suite of components into Toolpad, a low-code admin builder tool for assembling full-stack apps faster than ever.

Learn more about MUI's products in this blog post: An introduction to the MUI ecosystem https://mui.com/blog/mui-product-comparison/.





THE CULTURE

MUI is a fully remote company with a team that spans the globe. The majority of our work is asynchronous, and we rely on written communication to collaborate. We're radically transparent: nearly all of our work happens in public. Each contributor has the freedom to decide how and when they work, and that work is primarily self-directed: it's your responsibility to define and complete your own tasks in a timely manner.

For additional details about the culture, you can check our careers https://mui.com/careers/ and about https://mui.com/about/ pages and also our public Handbook https://mui-org.notion.site/Handbook-f086d47e10794d5e839aef9dc67f324b.





WHY WE'RE HIRING

The charts team (part of MUI X) needs your help. The component is off to a great start https://npm-stat.com/charts.html?package=%40mui%2Fx-charts&from=2021-06-01, however, we have only started to scratch the surface of the potential of this component. There is x10 more to build.

To be more specific in what we are aiming to achieve in the short to mid-term:

 - A tighter integration with the rest of the MUI libraries including Material UI and MUI X Data Grid

 - Faster iteration cycles compared to popular open-source alternatives such as Recharts and Charts.js

This should allow us to reach 30% of the downloads of alternative React charting libraries, considering benchmark data in the short term. Developers value having a single touch point, but also one they trust, and one that integrates well into the rest of their application.

In the mid-term, we aspired for this charting library to become a standard in the React ecosystem, outgrowing Material UI or any other UI library. We believe we can achieve this with an open-core model. We will at least match the features available in the alternative open-source projects, licensed as MIT in MUI X Charts. We will then provide extra paid features so developers can use a single charting library, without the need to juggle with paid alternatives as they do today.

In the long term, we envision using the pro-code charting API as a distribution channel for building more abstract charting primitives, using low-code and AI.

Overall both our open-source community and our premium products are growing fast (x2 YoY). We need talented people to keep that going!



WHY THIS IS INTERESTING

The advanced components portfolio is still small, with a million interesting and challenging problems to solve.

Our products empower React developers to build awesome applications faster – we see millions of developers on MUI's docs every year, one million a month.



The role


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Depending on the day, you'll:

 - Help guide architectural decisions. The future of MUI is discussed and planned in our public RFCs and issues. You'll be helping drive these conversations and guiding MUI toward the best possible solutions.

 - Contribute to deep, meaningful refactors and feature releases. MUI is a complex codebase. Components we've shipped recently, such as the data grid and date pickers have required months of dedicated, careful work.

 - Reduce friction. A large amount of the work on MUI is reducing friction and making it easier to use. This might involve careful API design, identifying and fixing top bugs, creating easier-to-understand error messages, and writing documentation and blog posts about features you ship.

 - Collaborate with the community. Many small, as well as meaningful fixes and features, have been contributed by the community. Your role is to draw the best out of the community — to inspire those across the world to create and contribute through your reviews of their issues and pull requests.

 - Experiment and play. Great, unexpected features and heisenbug fixes have come from a number of sources — relentlessly methodical processes of elimination, free-flowing team collaboration, inspiration by adjacent libraries and projects, and difficult-to-explain individual strokes of brilliance. Whatever your preferred style is for creating new things that others might not have thought of, you'll find a welcome home on the team.

 - Take ownership of features from idea/mockup to live deployment. You'll shape and guide the direction of crucial new features, including new components.

 - Ship. Early and often. You'll iterate and ship frequently. You'll have a real impact on the end-user experience and you'll love working on a team that builds stunning UIs and prioritizes delivering real user value as often as possible.

 - You'll be interacting with the users on a regular basis, handling inbound support and feature requests (every developer helps with developer requests).



THE BEST PARTS OF THIS JOB

 - You'll be at the cutting edge of application development — working on one of the fastest-growing UI libraries on the market.

 - You'll be part of an active, open, friendly community of developers that are excited about building awesome applications.

 - Your role will be key to making MUI the go-to UI solution for building applications, websites, and design systems with React.



THE WORST PARTS OF THIS JOB

 - Shifting context. You will necessarily have to shift context and dive into a different feature before the current one is done. It may even be in an area of the codebase you're unfamiliar with or don't have a ton of understanding about. It's fun, rewarding work, but it can be very challenging.

 - We move quickly but don't sacrifice quality. We ship early, often, and quickly. You may not be initially comfortable with the cadence with which we ship high-quality features and improvements to end-users. By doing so, we sacrifice on solving each problem 100% in exchange for fast feedback. Solving 50-70% of the issue with quality should be enough for any given iteration. Our users quickly tell us when we haven't pushed a solution far enough.

 - MUI has a large codebase. You may bang your head against the wall at times, and then write tests to assist future you 😌. The work you will be doing is somewhat unique and idiosyncratic. You probably have not had a similar role before.

 - In open-source, you're faced with a nonstop stream of bug reports and support requests. That means you need to develop an intuition for when to ignore something, and when to dig in further.




WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for someone with strong front-end skills. More important than specific technical skills though is that you're a strong problem solver who loves to learn. Details matter to you.



REQUIRED

 - Expertise in the modern JavaScript ecosystem. MUI's open-source projects are built on the shoulders of giants, making use of technologies such as ES2021, TypeScript, Node.js, React, Next.js, Webpack, and Babel.

 - A track record of demonstrating an eye for product and solving real-world user problems. If you have a knack for solving problems at the root cause, shipping beautiful user interfaces and intuitive APIs, we want you on our team.

 - Experience building and shipping production code in a team setting with a passion for writing tested, performant, and high-quality code.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills. As part of the team, you'll interface both directly and indirectly with community members and enterprise customers, and contribute to user documentation. Clear communication is fundamental in creating intuitive and compelling resources.

 - Ability to dive into complex problems. You should be able to quickly assess, understand, and iterate upon aspects of our codebase.

 - Ready and willing to ask and answer questions. If you're comfortable saying you're unsure, asking for help; but equally reaching out to assist others, you'll be an incredible addition to our team. We thrive because of continuous learning. First-time mistakes should be celebrated, not blamed.

 - Experience or interest in drawing technologies. Charts use SVG and canvas which implies using other API than HTML/CSS. Hope you know them or enjoy discovering new documentation.

 - Avoid monolithic deliverables. You scope and stage your work into well-defined milestones to ship.

 - Past work with front-end infrastructure. Perhaps you've created your company's design system, written a Babel plugin, or written complex React components. It would be great if you could address this in your cover letter!


NICE TO HAVE (BUT NOT REQUIRED)

 - You've experience with charts. You have contributed to building chart libraries, integrated charts in a design system, or contributed to chart intensive applications. You have built complex and advanced features while making sure the accessibility was fully functional.

 - You've contributed to a design system before. You have worked on enterprise components in the past, maybe for internal use in your company. You have built complex and advanced features while making sure the accessibility was fully functional.

 - You've maintained an active repository before. Maybe you've helped maintain a popular open-source repository, or perhaps you've worked on internal repositories that saw contributions from multiple teams. Previous experience with highly active repository workflows is a definite plus for this role.

 - You have contributed code. A history of contributing to MUI's open-source projects is a plus.




BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION

We offer competitive compensation commensurate with your experience level and location and are prepared to pay top market rates for someone who can clearly exceed the role's expectations. You can find the other perks and benefits on the careers https://mui.com/careers/#perks-and-benefits page.

jobs.description:

Your main challenge

As a Graphic Designer at Gameloft Barcelona, you will help bring our games and brands to life beyond the game itself, creating high-quality visual assets for marketing, communication and promotional purposes.

Working under the supervision of the Studio Lead UI Artist, you will combine strong graphic design fundamentals with creativity and attention to detail to deliver engaging visuals while also providing graphic support to our local UI team.

You will work under the supervision of the Studio Lead UI Artist, collaborating with the local UI and art teams and supporting the creation of marketing and promotional materials for our games.

This role will give you the opportunity to develop your expertise across graphic design, game marketing and UI while contributing to the visual identity of internationally released games.

Whether you're a casual or hardcore gamer on any platform (we're cross-platform now!), we want you to feel like you belong. Be part of shaping the gaming industry with us!

Want to know more? Please visit our Website: www.gameloft.com

If the offer interests you, Join the Game!
