To manage the high volume of applications for the Sales Advisor role, we use an online assessment method for skills-based recruitment within some of our stores. You will need to complete it as part of the application and screening process. Your responses will be scored by an assessment tool that applies predefined criteria set by H&M Group.

After completing the assessment, you’ll have the opportunity to share feedback and ask questions. If you experience any difficulties or prefer an alternative assessment method, please contact recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative will not impact on your application.

For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice.

** We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

jobs.title: Director, IT Platform
jobs.description:
Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market?  Look no further than Veracode!

Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment.

Learn more at www.veracode.com, on the Veracode blog, and on LinkedIn and Twitter.

As Director of IT Platform at our dynamic, rapidly evolving global application security company, you will be accountable for designing and operating the internal technology platform that powers how work gets done across the business. You will evolve IT from a traditional support function into a cloud-native, AI-forward platform—connecting systems, automating workflows, and enabling scalable, efficient operations.

You will partner cross-functionally to shape how our systems, data, and processes work together—from employee lifecycle and access management to enterprise applications and business workflows—ensuring a secure, reliable, and scalable environment. You will translate strategy into clear priorities, measurable outcomes, and accountability while using data and operating metrics to identify risks, make informed decisions, and adjust resources as needed.

In addition, you will lead and develop a global IT organization across end-user computing, identity and access management, enterprise applications, and infrastructure. This is a highly visible role with the opportunity to redefine IT, accelerate execution, and enable the company’s next phase of growth. You will develop strong leaders, build organizational capability, influence priorities beyond IT, and lead complex cross-functional initiatives that advance Veracode’s broader business goals.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and execute the strategy to evolve IT into a cloud-native, AI-forward business platform, translating strategy into clear priorities, measurable outcomes, and accountability.

• Design and automate end-to-end business workflows to reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency.

• Own identity and access management, ensuring secure, automated, and policy-driven access across systems.

• Integrate enterprise systems to enable seamless workflows and consistent data across tools.

• Drive automation and self-service to reduce ticket volume and enhance the employee experience.

• Ensure platform reliability and stability, applying best practices (e.g., SLAs, observability, incident management, and rapid recovery).

• Leverage AI to streamline IT operations (e.g., ticket deflection, access recommendations, workflow automation).

• Drive adoption of AI across IT and internal workflows, scaling high-impact use cases.

• Lead and develop a global IT organization, building strong leaders, coaching managers, setting a high bar for performance, and developing organizational capability and succession.

• Partner cross-functionally and maintain stakeholder feedback loops to align IT platform capabilities with business priorities, navigate dependencies, communicate trade-offs, and drive continuous improvement.

• Partner with the GRC organization to establish and uphold standards and governance to support scale, security, and compliance.

• Partner with the Finance organization on budget and spend to ensure costs are managed, including SaaS/PaaS spend and IT-related public cloud spend.

Experience & Capabilities:

• 10+ years of experience leading IT, platform, or enterprise technology functions in a SaaS or technology-driven organization.

• Proven experience transforming IT from a traditional support model into an automated, platform-oriented function.

• Demonstrated success designing and automating end-to-end workflows across enterprise systems, reducing manual processes, and improving efficiency.

• Deep experience with identity and access management, including provisioning, access lifecycle, and policy-driven access at scale.

• Strong experience integrating SaaS enterprise systems and enabling seamless data flow across tools.

• Experience operating systems with a focus on reliability and stability, including incident management, uptime, and recovery (SRE-inspired practices).

• Experience applying AI and automation to improve IT operations and internal workflows.

• Experience with cloud-native environments, DevOps best practices and modern SaaS/PaaS platform architectures.

• Proven ability to lead transformation, influence senior stakeholders, and drive adoption across a global organization.

• Strong business judgment and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate complex organizational decisions, dive into critical issues when needed, and maintain accountability for outcomes.

• Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build alignment across teams, clearly communicate recommendations and trade-offs, and lead complex cross-functional initiatives.

• Strategic leadership capability, with the ability to connect IT priorities to broader business outcomes and shape the talent, organization, and culture needed to deliver sustained results.

What we offer you:

• Outstanding Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage to meet all your healthcare needs.

• Wellness benefits to help you focus on what’s most important.

• “Take What You Need” time off policy.

• Extensive development and training offerings to help you grow your career at Veracode.

• Generous 401k match to help save for your future.

• Amazing community of professionals who take pride in what we do every day.

Compensation Transparency

In accordance with U.S. pay transparency laws, Veracode provides compensation transparency for roles based in the United States. Click here to view our compensation ranges by grade. Please note, specific compensation may be influenced by various factors including candidates experience, education, and work location.

Job Grade: Director

Employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Fraudulent Recruitment Alert - Be Aware and Stay Informed

At Veracode, we prioritize a secure recruitment process. Unfortunately, fake recruitment and job offer scams are on the rise. They aim to deceive candidates through emails and calls to obtain sensitive information.

Here’s our recruitment promise to you:

• Comprehensive Interview Process: We never extend job offers without a comprehensive interview process involving our recruitment team and hiring managers.

• Offer Communications: Our job offers are not sent solely through email, and we will never ask you to pay for your own hardware.

• Email Verification: Recruiting emails from Veracode will always originate from an “@veracode.com" email address.

If you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter, or telephone communication claiming to be from Veracode, please reach out to us at careers@veracode.com before taking any further action.

Are you ready to be part of a team committed to providing the best possible patient and client experience? If this interests you, please come for a shadow day and talk with our long-tenured staff to see for yourself the rewarding work our anesthesiologists are doing!

AAC Pacific Northwest is expanding, and we have an immediate need for a personable, patient-centered 1099 Anesthesiologist to service our office-based dental practice in Wenatchee, WA.

• The Anesthesiologist must be comfortable providing independent nasal intubation/TIVA to healthy pediatric dental patients.

• Thursdays and Fridays

• We start between 5:30 and 6:00 AM, and all cases end between 1:30 and 2:00 PM.

• No call, no weekends, evenings, or holidays.

Applicant Qualifications:

• ABA certified or ABA eligible

• Previous experience in an ASC, hospital, or office-based setting

• Willingness to work independently in a fast-paced pediatric dental environment

• Reliable transportation

What is office-based anesthesia? AAC PNW is dedicated to providing a safe anesthetic experience to each and every patient at the dental office, allowing the dentist to perform procedures safely in the comfort of their offices. Our clinical model provides the dentist with an anesthesia provider and all of the anesthesia-related medications, supplies, and equipment on the day of their scheduled procedures. We specialize in administering general anesthesia to the pediatric dental patient on a daily basis and have become very safe and efficient because of it. Our clinical staff's morale, culture, and loyalty are unmatched, and we encourage you to talk with our anesthesiologists and see them in action!

Excited? We know we are! Apply today — we look forward to meeting you!

jobs.title: IT Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

 - We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

 - We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

 - We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.


ABOUT THE TEAM

The IT Platform & Automation team builds and runs Legora’s identity, device and SaaS systems, working with Workplace Technology, Information Security and business teams to keep them reliable as Legora grows.

As an IT Automation Engineer, you’ll own Serval and find automation opportunities independently and in partnership with your peers. You’ll also partner with People Technology on HRIS integrations and automation. You’ll build workflows using automation platforms and AI agents, verify their effects in connected systems and read generated code when it helps you troubleshoot.

Our stack includes Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Serval and Lumos, with Fleet for Apple device management. Automation is the main focus, with occasional employee support and troubleshooting.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 - Own Serval: manage its day-to-day operation, configuration and integrations. Keep workflows reliable and documented so teammates can support them and know who owns each part.

 - Find work worth automating: identify and deliver opportunities independently and in partnership with your peers. Assess which are worth pursuing and take them through rollout and maintenance.

 - Build workflows and integrations: use automation platforms and AI agents for onboarding and offboarding, access provisioning, SaaS administration and keeping data consistent across systems.

 - Support People systems integrations: work with People Technology to build and test integrations between our HRIS and other business systems.

 - Build AI-enabled services: help employees find information and complete approved actions. Set permissions, approval steps and fallbacks for uncertain answers or failed actions.

 - Plan and deliver changes: compare approaches and explain the tradeoffs in reliability, complexity, cost and employee experience. Coordinate dependencies with system owners and use staged rollouts with appropriate recovery steps.

 - Test workflows: use automated checks to catch failures and regressions, and verify results in connected systems.

 - Keep workflows running: monitor outcomes and fix recurring failures. Use run histories, logs and API responses to trace problems across systems, reading generated code when it helps.

 - Measure the results: track changes in manual effort, errors, delays or control gaps. Check that people can use what you’ve built, incorporate feedback and finish any follow-up work.


WHO YOU ARE

 - Practical automation experience: you’ve identified useful opportunities and built workflows or integrations that others use. You can explain their impact and how you maintain them.

 - Comfortable with platforms and agents: you can translate requirements into instructions, configure integrations and adjust workflows based on results.

 - Careful about testing: you know how to test a workflow and verify its effects in connected systems, using automated checks where useful.

 - Sound judgment about AI output: you can assess accuracy, consistency and usefulness, and know when to investigate or ask for human review.

 - Able to follow technical logic: you understand workflows and how data moves through APIs. You can read generated code when troubleshooting calls for it.

 - Experience in corporate IT: you’ve worked with identity, SaaS or IT systems and understand how account, group and access changes affect employees.

 - Comfortable with some ambiguity: you can plan work when requirements are unclear and coordinate with the people it depends on. You explain tradeoffs and know when a decision needs someone else’s approval.

 - Accountable after launch: you’re comfortable owning a system’s day-to-day operation, resolving problems and helping others use it.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with Serval or a similar platform for AI-enabled workflows and service automation.

 - Experience automating processes using HRIS APIs.

 - Familiarity with Okta, Lumos, SSO, SCIM, employee lifecycle integrations or Apple device management.

 - Experience connecting AI agents to tools and knowledge sources, setting their permissions or evaluating their performance.

 - Experience setting up automated workflow tests, regression checks or monitoring across applications.


WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

 - Global collaboration: Partner with teams and clients across Europe, APAC, and North America.

 - Competitive package: Comprehensive salary, benefits, and tools for success.

 - Meaningful work: Your efforts shape how thousands of lawyers use AI daily.

 - In-person environment: Union Square office designed for ambitious builders and company provided lunch daily.


BENEFITS & PERKS

We invest in our people with a comprehensive, thoughtfully designed benefits package:

Medical, dental & vision

 - Multiple medical plan options through Aetna and Kaiser Permanente

 - HSA or Healthcare FSA (based on plan selection)

 - Dental plans via MetLife

 - Vision plans via Vision Care

Family support

 - Generous parental leave

 - Free One Medical membership for employees and dependents

Additional perks

 - Pre-tax commuter benefits

 - Life Insurance + STD/LTD

 - 401(K) with generous company match

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Robust voluntary benefits, including identity protection (via Aura), legal coverage via MetLife, pet savings programs, and more

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Application Lifecycle
jobs.description:
About the Team

ServiceNow's Application Lifecycle Engineering organization builds the platforms and tools that enable customers and developers to create, validate, deploy, and maintain applications at enterprise scale.

The team owns critical developer platform capabilities that improve developer productivity, application quality, and software delivery efficiency across the ServiceNow ecosystem. Our products support automated testing, application lifecycle management, CI/CD integration, developer tooling, and emerging AI-powered capabilities that help customers build software faster and more confidently.

As we continue investing in AI-native development experiences, we're focused on reimagining how developers build, test, validate, and operate applications through intelligent automation, agentic systems, and modern platform engineering practices.

What You'll Do

As a Principal Software Engineer, you'll help define the technical strategy and architecture for the next generation of developer platforms and AI-powered engineering productivity solutions.

• Lead architecture and technical direction across developer tooling, automated testing, and application lifecycle management platforms.
• Design and build highly scalable platform services that improve developer productivity and software quality for enterprise customers.
• Create prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and reference architectures to validate new technical approaches before broader adoption.
• Drive innovation around AI-enabled developer experiences, intelligent automation, agentic workflows, and software delivery acceleration.
• Partner closely with Product Management, Design, and Engineering leaders to translate strategic vision into technical execution.
• Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to enhance platform capabilities, developer experience, and customer outcomes.
• Influence architectural decisions across multiple engineering teams and help establish engineering standards and best practices.
• Solve complex challenges related to scalability, reliability, observability, security, and performance across customer-facing platforms.
• Mentor senior engineers and provide technical leadership through influence, collaboration, and technical excellence.
• Contribute to long-term platform evolution while balancing customer impact and execution velocity.

Required

• 15+ years of software engineering experience or equivalent practical experience.
• Deep expertise building large-scale distributed systems, developer platforms, cloud-native applications, or enterprise SaaS products.
• Strong experience designing customer-facing platform capabilities, developer tools, or engineering productivity solutions.
• Expert-level understanding of system architecture, scalability, reliability, observability, fault tolerance, and production operations.
• Strong software development background with Java and modern distributed system design.
• Proven ability to drive technical strategy and influence architecture across multiple teams and organizations.
• Experience leading complex technical initiatives through collaboration rather than formal authority.
• Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively across Engineering, Product Management, and Design organizations.
• Track record of mentoring senior engineers and raising engineering standards across an organization.

Preferred

• Experience building developer tools, testing platforms, CI/CD systems, developer experience (DevEx) solutions, or application lifecycle management products.
• Experience with automated testing frameworks, testability platforms, or software quality engineering at scale.
• Experience developing AI-powered products, AI-assisted developer workflows, agentic systems, or intelligent automation capabilities.
• Knowledge of software development lifecycle tooling, deployment automation, and platform engineering practices.
• Experience building products used by software developers, administrators, or highly technical enterprise customers.
• Familiarity with developer productivity metrics, platform adoption strategies, and customer-centric platform development.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $221,200 - $387,100, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Accommodations

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Full-Time | Tempe, AZ or San Francisco, CA




ABOUT BASATA

At Basata, we're rethinking the way healthcare practices get work done. Our AI-powered tools help automate the repetitive, time-consuming tasks that bog teams down, so staff can spend less time on admin and more time with patients.

We're a small, fast-moving team that loves building smart systems and simple, intuitive experiences. If you're someone who gets excited about early-stage energy, designing better ways to work, and fixing what's broken in healthcare, we'd love to connect.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a standout Senior Full-Stack Engineer to help build our AI-powered software, used every day by clinic staff and administrators. You'll work across the stack, use scalable design patterns and best practices, and create delightful, user-friendly experiences in a space that's technically complex but rooted in human impact.



You'll spend most of your time building. You'll also spend a real part of it reviewing other engineers' designs and code, because we want the standards you hold yourself to become the standards of the team.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design, build, and maintain scalable, high-quality features across the entire stack, from our React/TypeScript frontend to our Java/Spring Boot backend and Python for our AI/ML services.

 - Collaborate closely with the CTO on key architectural decisions and help define and maintain the architectural standards the team builds against, ensuring our systems are robust, scalable, and built for the long term. Staff-level hires will own architectural direction across services.

 - Review pull requests and design proposals from other engineers, and hold the line on design and software-engineering principles so the codebase stays coherent as the team grows.

 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers: review their designs before they build, pair with them on hard problems, and give feedback that changes how they work, not just the PR in front of you.

 - Contribute to and improve our cloud infrastructure and our CI/CD pipelines to ensure a fast, reliable development and release cycle.

 - Partner with product and design stakeholders to translate complex healthcare workflows into simple, intuitive, and delightful user experiences.

 - Champion software quality by implementing comprehensive testing strategies (unit, integration, E2E) and promoting development best practices across the team.

 - Write clear, maintainable documentation for code, architecture, and processes to set the standard for future engineering hires.

 - Contribute to product and UX thinking, actively shaping what gets built, not just how.
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production-grade, full-stack web applications. Staff-level candidates will have 10+ years of experience with a track record of technical leadership.

 - Experience mentoring engineers and reviewing design work, with examples of feedback that changed the outcome.

 - Hands-on experience building, deploying, and maintaining LLM-based agentic applications in production is essential.

 - Deep expertise in backend development using Java and the Spring Boot framework.

 - Strong proficiency with modern frontend development using React and TypeScript.

 - Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and deploying applications to modern cloud environments.
   
   


WHY JOIN BASATA?

 - Drive real impact. Your work helps clinics run more smoothly and gets patients care faster, with fewer headaches.

 - Shape something meaningful. You'll play a real role in both the systems and the experience, not just execute someone else's design.

 - High ownership. We trust you to lead, build, and bring ideas to life.

 - Work with purpose. We're solving real problems in healthcare with tools people rely on every day.
   
   


OUR CORE VALUES

 - Find a way: We own outcomes — no excuses, no shortcuts. Whatever the challenge, we find a way.

 - Dream big: We refuse to accept that healthcare has to be broken, and we act deliberately to build a better version of it.

 - Obsess over the customer: Every decision starts with empathy for the people we serve — without compromising ethics, privacy, or trust.

 - Always be learning: We're relentless about growth — our own and each other's — because it makes us better teammates and leaders.

 - Move fast, deliver excellence: Speed unlocks momentum, but only paired with precision. We test, ship, and iterate quickly, and hold a high bar.

Our scheduling model is built around flexibility, so you can shape a week that works for your life outside the OR — whether that's family time, outdoor activities, or simply a better rhythm.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
About Campfire
Campfire is a next-gen core accounting platform built for modern mid-market finance teams. We've grown 10x in the past year by replacing outdated legacy ERPs and manual accounting processes with automation-driven solutions. As a Deployment Strategist, you'll be on the front line of getting customers live — owning the technical execution that turns a signed contract into a fully operational finance system.

The Role
This is an execution-focused, hands-on role responsible for driving successful platform deployments from kickoff to go-live. You'll own the implementation lifecycle end-to-end: scoping, configuration, data migration, testing, and launch. Success looks like customers up and running quickly, cleanly, and confidently — with the systems, integrations, and workflows they need to run their finance operations day one.

What you'll do

 - Own deployments end-to-end, from kickoff through go-live and post-launch stabilization

 - Configure the platform to match each customer's accounting workflows, reporting structures, and integration requirements

 - Lead data migration from source systems (NetSuite, SAP, QuickBooks, Sage, Oracle), ensuring accuracy, completeness, and clean cutover

 - Build and execute testing and validation plans across financial workflows and integrations

 - Manage project plans, timelines, and dependencies across multiple concurrent implementations

 - Identify technical and delivery risks early — across data, systems, and process — and resolve them before they impact launch

 - Partner closely with Product and Engineering to unblock issues and feed customer needs back into the roadmap

 - Ensure a clean handoff to post-implementation support

What we're looking for

 - Proven experience leading software implementations, system rollouts, or technical deployments

 - Strong comfort with data migration, system configuration, and integrations

 - Working knowledge of ERP systems (NetSuite, SAP, QuickBooks, Sage, Oracle) and financial data structures

 - Sharp project-management instincts — able to run multiple deployments in parallel without dropping details

 - A problem-solver who spots risk early and drives issues to resolution

 - Excellent stakeholder communication, with a customer-first mindset

 - Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment

 - CPA or Accounting background is a plus.

jobs.title: Director of Implementation
jobs.description:
ABOUT AUGUST HEALTH

At August Health, our mission is to empower the essential work of caring for our elders.

We achieve this by providing a modern operating platform and electronic health record (EHR) that enables senior living operators to deliver high-quality care with confidence.

Caregivers are the heart of senior living communities, embodying care, compassion, and well-being. Yet, they face increasing challenges—higher resident acuity, complex workflows, and staffing shortages. At August Health, we build tools that simplify their tasks, eliminate inefficiencies, and provide the insights they need to focus on what truly matters—caring for residents.

At August, we strive to live our values each day, in every interaction with our customers and with each other.

 - Be responsible – leave things better than you found them

 - Take ownership – be decisive and take action

 - Be ambitious – build something great

 - Keep an open mindset – communicate candidly and welcome new ideas

 - Be humble – celebrate each others’ successes and learn from our mistakes

 - Stay positive – assume best intent




ABOUT THE ROLE

As Director of Implementation, you will lead the team responsible for taking customers from signed contract through successful go-live—and for implementing new products, communities, acquisitions, and other expansions for customers already live on August Health.

This is both a leadership and builder role. You’ll be responsible for the people, strategy, processes, and systems behind how we implement August Health as we continue to scale. You'll develop a deep understanding of our customers and our entire platform, enabling you to coach the team, navigate our most complex implementations, identify opportunities to improve how we work, and partner closely with teams across August.

We’re looking for someone who is equally comfortable leading a team, diving into the details, and building what doesn’t exist yet. You won't carry a traditional Implementation Manager book of business, but you should be capable of stepping into an implementation, understanding the customer and configuration, and helping drive it forward when needed.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Lead and develop a high-performing Implementation team. Manage and coach Implementation Managers across both net-new and live-customer implementations, creating clarity around expectations, ownership, development, and performance. Build the team and organizational structure needed as August continues to grow.

Own the implementation experience from post-sale through go-live. Be accountable for the strategy and execution behind customer implementations across August's platform, ensuring customers launch successfully and are positioned for long-term success before transitioning to Customer Success. Our current IMs own the full cycle from discovery/configuration through go-live and early stabilization, so this leader needs to understand that work deeply.

Own implementation for customers as they grow and evolve. Oversee implementations for live customers adopting new products, adding communities through organic growth or acquisitions, navigating operator transitions, and otherwise expanding their use of August. These projects often require quickly understanding complex existing configurations and adapting them on accelerated timelines.

Build for scale. Continuously evaluate how we implement and identify opportunities to make the experience more efficient, repeatable, and effective. Develop the processes, playbooks, tooling, metrics, and operating rhythms that allow the team to support increasing customer and product complexity without simply adding headcount.

Develop deep product and implementation expertise. Understand August Health's products, configurations, workflows, integrations, and implementation methodology well enough to coach others, troubleshoot complex situations, challenge assumptions, and step directly into the work when necessary.

Use technology to make the team better. Look beyond traditional process improvements and identify opportunities to automate or eliminate manual work. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you should be technically curious and comfortable using modern AI and no/low-code tools to prototype solutions, improve internal workflows, and partner effectively with technical teammates to turn ideas into scalable tools.

Be the escalation point for complexity—not simply problems. Help the team navigate ambiguous implementations, challenging customer dynamics, novel configurations, and situations where the existing playbook isn't enough. Create structure, make decisions, and help the team move forward.

Partner across August Health. Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Product, Engineering, and Data to ensure clean handoffs, surface customer and implementation insights, influence product priorities, and continuously improve the end-to-end customer journey. Cross-functional partnership is already central to the underlying Implementation Manager roles.

Know what's happening across the portfolio. Build the visibility and operating cadence necessary to understand implementation health, capacity, risks, timelines, and outcomes across the team—and use those insights to proactively address issues and improve our strategy.




THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

You may be a great fit if you:

 - Have 7+ years of experience in Implementation, Professional Services, Customer Success, Program Management, or a related customer-facing function, ideally in B2B SaaS, healthcare technology, or another complex software environment

 - Have 3+ years of people leadership experience, with a track record of developing strong teams and leaders

 - Have led complex, multi-stakeholder software implementations and understand what excellent implementation looks like from both the customer and company perspective

 - Are a builder at heart—you naturally notice inefficient processes, unclear ownership, or missing infrastructure and want to make them better

 - Can move comfortably between strategy and execution: you're capable of designing the implementation operating model in one conversation and digging into the details of a challenging customer configuration in the next

 - Are highly systems-oriented and technically curious; you don't need to be an engineer, but technology and automation are tools you instinctively reach for when solving operational problems

 - Are excited by the potential of AI-assisted tooling and automation and comfortable experimenting with new ways to make teams more effective

 - Can quickly understand complex products, customer workflows, data structures, and system configurations

 - Communicate exceptionally well and can build credibility with everyone from an Implementation Manager to a customer's C-suite

 - Are comfortable operating in ambiguity and creating structure where it doesn't yet exist—a trait already emphasized in the existing enterprise implementation role.

 - Care deeply about the customer experience while also understanding that delivering a great experience at scale requires strong processes, clear expectations, and operational discipline

 - Bring healthcare or senior living experience as a plus, but not necessarily a requirement; your existing Billing IM profile similarly treats industry experience as teachable when the candidate brings the right underlying aptitude.




ABOUT OUR TEAM

Our team brings together deep expertise in technology, healthcare, and company-building. We’ve led teams at Apple, Google, Landmark Health, and Adobe, co-founded and exited multiple companies, shipped products used by hundreds of millions of users, and managed clinical teams caring for thousands of patients.

Backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are partnering with some of the largest senior care organizations in the U.S. to transform the future of senior living.

We offer market-competitive compensation based on experience and ability, including significant equity option grants. Our benefits prioritize your well-being with 100% company-paid premiums for health, dental, and vision coverage, along with company contributions to your HSA. We help you plan for the future with a 2% 401(k) match, and support your physical and mental health through services like Rightway Health Advocacy and Spring Health Mental Wellness. Beyond traditional benefits, we offer a flexible time off policy, 100% paid family leave, and all-expenses-paid, in-person company offsites twice a year.

jobs.title: Field Operator - Kansas City, MO
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Field Operator, you will serve as Traba's in-market operational hands — focused on recruiting, onboarding, and preparing workers for placement across the market. Rather than being anchored to a single customer, you'll support the broader market and may interact with multiple customer sites as volume and coverage needs dictate.

You'll be the local face of Traba to our workforce: building community partnerships, running onboarding sessions, and making sure every worker is vetted, prepared, and ready to succeed on their first shift. This role requires professionalism, strong recruiting instincts, and the flexibility to flex across worker funnel needs in a fast-paced environment.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Worker Relationship Management: Build strong relationships with workers across the market — owning the experience from recruiting through placement and providing timely updates, feedback, and support.

 - Community & Partner Relationships: Develop and maintain relationships with workforce centers, community organizations, and local partners to drive worker pipeline and brand presence in the market.

 - Worker Vetting & Onboarding: Oversee worker vetting, drug testing, and onboarding end-to-end, including running large group onboarding sessions when volume calls for it.

 - Worker Funnel Management: Manage the full worker funnel — sourcing, screening, scheduling, and converting applicants into placement-ready workers.

 - New Start Scheduling: Coordinate interviews and start schedules for new hires across customer sites, ensuring workers are matched to the right opportunities at the right time.

 - PPE & On-Site Support: Distribute and manage PPE, and provide on-site presence at customer facilities as needed to support new starts, escalations, or peak coverage.

 - Communication & Reporting: Maintain consistent, proactive feedback loops with Traba HQ — flagging market trends, funnel issues, or coverage risks early.


REQUIREMENTS

 - High School Diploma or equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred.

 - Bilingual (English & Spanish) a plus, not required.

 - 1–2+ years of experience in operations or customer-facing environments, including but not limited to: staffing, manufacturing, warehouse, retail, food service, teaching, or on-site coordination.

 - Strong recruiting instincts and the ability to source, screen, and convert candidates.

 - Comfortable running large group onboarding sessions and presenting in front of workers.

 - Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills (email and in-person).

 - Professional demeanor and ability to represent Traba with workers, partners, and client stakeholders.

 - Flexible and adaptable — able to shift priorities and locations as market needs evolve.

 - Organized, detail-oriented, and a proactive problem solver.

 - Comfortable working in fast-paced, dynamic warehouse and field environments.


COMPENSATION

Competitive hourly base pay plus performance-based incentives tied to worker onboarding and successful placements.

Job: People Partner

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY

At Salesloft, our People Partner is a pivotal part of our success as the go-to for all employee relations. You will work closely with managers to ensure flawless execution of employee support across the organization, and — with the help of the broader People team — manage employee questions, concerns, and offboarding, including investigations, exit surveys, and interviews. - Partner closely with managers to ensure consistent, high-quality employee support across the organization.

- Analyze workforce trends and metrics to recommend action plans that improve engagement and retention.

- Lead the creation and maintenance of company policies, ensuring compliance with applicable laws and company direction.

- Craft corporate communications that land clearly across all levels of the organization.

- Serve as the subject matter expert on employee questions — benefits, perks, and processes.

In addition to working with amazing colleagues who live our core values every day, you will have the opportunity to shape the employee experience for a fast-growing team. You will have an opportunity to make a difference.

We are seeking a self-starting, organized individual who is passionate about contributing to the success of their peers and thrives in a fast-paced environment. You excel at juggling multiple priorities and thoroughly enjoy providing a white-glove employee experience.

jobs.title: Global Supply Manager (Falcon/Dragon/Starfall)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

GLOBAL SUPPLY MANAGER (FALCON / DRAGON / STARFALL)

Falcon 9, Falcon Heavy, and Dragon fly at a cadence the rest of the industry still treats as a goal. That only works if the right hardware is on the floor, at the right cost, from a supply base that can actually scale. SpaceX is looking for a Global Supply Manager to own a Falcon / Dragon commodity book end to end — strategy, source selection, contracts, coverage, cost, and continuity of supply.

You will run a live production supply base and partner with engineering, supplier development, planning, production, quality, finance, and legal. You will take competitive sourcing from RFQ to award, convert strategy into long-term agreements and purchase orders, and walk cost and risk into leadership review yourself. This is not a coordinator seat. You own the book.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Develop and execute global supply agreements and sourcing strategy for an assigned Falcon / Dragon commodity; ensure partners are tooled, capacitated, and ready for prototype, ramp, and rate production

• Own continuity of supply from concept through end of life, including coverage, need dates, dual-source, sub-tier risk, and escalation when delivery or quality is at risk

• Lead RFI, RFP, and RFQ processes with engineering, supplier development, quality, and planning; evaluate bids, present the sourcing recommendation, and close award

• Negotiate price, payment terms, capacity, lead time, and contract vehicles; place and manage purchase orders that hold cost targets without breaking delivery or quality

• Build should-cost and competitive-quote discipline; present value propositions to SpaceX management on contract award, cost reviews, cost-reduction strategy, and critical supply issues

• Develop commodity expertise — market trends, process capability, cost drivers, and supplier technical limits — and use it to inform design-for-manufacturability and source selection, not only commercial terms

• Build a commodity and technology roadmap aligned to future Falcon / Dragon rate and design changes; identify suppliers whose process portfolio matches that roadmap

• Define and report KPIs (coverage, on-time delivery, price, capacity, and supply risk) and drive internal and external process improvements from the data

• Serve as the liaison between supply chain and engineering for supplier down-select on new product introduction while holding or improving cost targets

• Develop and maintain strong supplier partnerships; secure the right resources on SpaceX programs and hold vendors to delivery, quality, and commercial commitments

• Issue and manage purchase orders, resolve invoices, and close the loop on quality and cost so tactical execution does not leak while strategy is being built

• Prepare clear sourcing recommendations that leadership can approve: spend, cost impact, need date, risk, and technical alignment — and own the result after award

• Guide junior sourcing, buying, or planning teammates; take ownership of team effort on cost and sourcing strategy for existing platforms and new product

• Conduct all activities with the highest level of integrity and in accordance with SpaceX procurement policy and procedure

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Advanced degree and 4+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; or bachelor’s degree and 6+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; or 10+ years of experience working in one or more of the following:

• Engineering

• Purchasing

• Contract negotiation

• Material or production planning

• Operations or supply chain management

• Material cost control

• Master production scheduling

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience managing a domestic and international production supply base through rate — not only new-product introduction or one-off buys

• Deep commodity experience in technical procurement: precision machining, raw material, tube bending, valves, mechanisms, welding, outside processing, or equivalent aerospace / automotive hardware

• Proven track record of owning a commodity book, negotiating preferred pricing, and delivering cost, coverage, and delivery results

• Strong individual negotiation skill with the ability to influence engineering, suppliers, and leadership

• Experience running RFX processes and converting them into long-term agreements or volume buys

• Experience planning purchases of commodity hardware and third-party services with product development, quality, finance, and production

• Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills; advanced Excel and comfort building the analysis, not only reviewing it

• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to put a cost and risk story in front of senior leadership and answer the first question

• Detail-oriented, self-motivated, and able to move quickly in a fast-changing production environment

• Experience mentoring junior sourcing, buying, or planning teammates

• Experience in aerospace, aviation, automotive, or other high-rate manufacturing supply chain

• Working knowledge of ERP / MRP purchasing systems (SAP, Oracle, or equivalent)

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed to support production, launch, and critical supplier issues

• Willingness to travel to suppliers, other SpaceX sites, and source-inspection or recovery trips as required

• This is a hands-on role: expect time on the production floor, at the supplier, and in the data — not only in meetings

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:

Level 3: $135,000.00 - $200,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

jobs.title: Head of Accounting & Advisory Partnerships
jobs.description:
WHAT WE DO

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.




WHO WE ARE

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.





WHO WE NEED

As Head of Accounting & Advisory Partnerships, you will lead one of Rillet’s most important growth functions.

You’ll own our strategy across the Big 4, top accounting firms, mid-market boutiques, and the long-tail of high value Fractional CFOs  — building relationships that translate into pipeline, revenue, and long-term market advantage.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll own the number, lead and inspire a growing team, and represent Rillet with senior executives across the industry. You will orchestrate the partnerships engine, while still stepping in to close a partner, create the pitch, or solve what is not working. You will also be responsible for working cross-functionally with leadership across Sales, Solutions, Marketing, Customer Success, and Rillet’s PE Partnerships team to build the infrastructure that drives outcomes at scale.

We’re looking for teammates who are based near our New York City or San Francisco offices, or open to relocating. Our hybrid schedule brings the team together in person on Tuesdays through Thursdays. This role requires significant travel.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own channel revenue. Build the strategy, pipeline, and operating cadence to grow the team’s revenue.

 - Build the infrastructure. Effectively enable partner cross-sell, up-level Rillet’s sales process to work productively with partners, create repeatable go-to-market motions, and build & manage an engaging events calendar.

 - Identify & execute on strategic initiatives. Work with partner on longer-term bets and ancillary opportunities beyond near-term revenue generation.

 - Lead and scale the team. Hire, coach, inspire, and raise the bar for a high-performing partnerships organization.

 - Represent Rillet at the highest levels. Build credibility with C-suite executives, senior partners, and industry leaders and become a trusted ambassador for Rillet.

 - Turn relationships into outcomes. Create repeatable programs that generate pipeline, customers, and strategic value — not just logos or introductions.

 - Raise the communication bar. Build exceptional presentations, pitches, and partner materials, and coach the team to do the same.

 - Lead across Rillet. Partner closely with every function at Rillet to make the team successful.




WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years of experience, ideally with an analytical foundation (accounting, MBB consulting, IB/PE experience). Experience working with advisory firms strongly preferred

 - You have led and scaled a strategic partnerships, or channel function with clear accountability for revenue.

 - You have managed and developed strong teams, and people want to work for you, learn from you, and follow your leadership.

 - You are exceptionally execution oriented – move fast, make decisions with incomplete information, run through walls, and simply get things done. You are allergic to analysis paralysis

 - You have exceptional executive presence and can build credibility with senior leaders across complex, sophisticated organizations.

 - You are a relentless, low-ego builder who thrives in white space and is comfortable doing the work yourself before there is a playbook around you.

 - You move quickly and adapt easily without losing your point of view or focus on the number.

 - You have a team mindset. Rillet is a highly collaborative company with complex go-to-market and delivery operations. You need others on your side.

 - Experience with events, conferences, and ecosystem-building is a strong plus.



The expected OTE range for this role is $260,000–$280,000 in New York City and San Francisco. Final compensation within this range will depend on factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and the scope of the role. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.

Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com http://rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.




LIFE AT RILLET

 - Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

 - Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.

 - Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

 - Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

jobs.title: Structural Analyst
jobs.description:
ABOUT MATTER INTELLIGENCE

Welcome to Matter, where we are building the future of vision AI: pairing a world-first sensor that sees molecular chemistry, temperature, and 3D shape with a Large World Model that will be the most powerful intelligence engine for the physical world. This system doesn't just see what something looks like; it understands everything from a single pixel. We call this Superintelligent Vision.

Our team has delivered technologies to Mars for NASA/JPL, designed advanced sensors for U.S. Defense, and built core infrastructure at OpenAI. We are now building the next generation of space- and airborne-based sensing systems.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Matter is hiring a Structural Analyst to evaluate and improve the structural performance of sensing payloads and supporting hardware for airborne and space environments. The role will work closely with mechanical, optomechanical, systems, and test engineers from early design through qualification.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Perform structural analyses that inform payload and component design decisions.

 - Evaluate expected loads, stiffness, margins, and dynamic behavior across relevant operating and test environments.

 - Partner with designers and engineers to identify structural risks and recommend practical design changes.

 - Support test planning, instrumentation, data review, and correlation between analysis and observed performance.

 - Document assumptions, methods, results, and design margins for technical reviews and program decisions.


QUALIFICATIONS


REQUIRED

 - Strong foundation in structural mechanics and engineering analysis.

 - Experience applying analysis methods to real hardware and interpreting results for design teams.

 - Ability to communicate assumptions, uncertainty, and design implications clearly.

 - Collaborative approach to working across mechanical, systems, manufacturing, and test functions.


PREFERRED

 - Experience with aerospace, precision instrumentation, optical payloads, or other high-performance hardware.

 - Experience correlating analytical models with environmental or qualification test data.

 - Familiarity with lightweight structures, dynamic environments, and tight alignment requirements.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Structural risks and margins are understood early enough to guide design decisions.

 - Analyses are traceable, reviewable, and aligned with test and qualification plans.

 - The team enters integration and test with confidence in the structural design and its operating limits.


LOCATION

This role is based in El Segundo, CA, and requires onsite work.


ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To comply with U.S. export regulations, applicants must be one of the following:

 - A U.S. citizen or national

 - A lawful permanent resident (green card holder)

 - Eligible to obtain required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State


EMPLOYEE OFFERINGS AND BENEFITS

At Matter, we believe in rewarding high performance and providing the support you need to thrive. Our compensation and benefits package includes:

 - Competitive compensation based on experience

 - Early-stage equity package

 - 100% employer-paid health, dental, and vision coverage

 - Opportunity to work on novel sensing, data, and AI systems with real-world deployment paths to the largest industries in the world

Matter Intelligence is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds who can raise the ambition and performance of the team.

As a master planner and business data analyst at Matter, you will have insight into every aspect of Matter’s work, from instrument engineering, research and development, facility and resource planning, data analysis, machine learning and the construction of Matter’s superintelligent vision ecosystem. You will not need to be an expert in all or any of these areas, but familiarity will be extremely valuable, and you will be crucial in helping our team organize, plan and execute their work.

You will work closely with program management and team members, maintaining the Matter Integrated Master Schedule, establishing / maintaining traceability to lower-level scheduling and planning tools used by team members, assist engineers and scientists in organizing and planning their work, and help create and use data analytics tools to measure and report on team execution and performance.

You will also assist the program management team in creating, reviewing and analyzing other data sets relevant to the performance and execution of Matter’s work, which may include MRP/material requirements planning and supply chain, product development plans and reports, and budgeting, cost, and schedule performance, both internally and with input from vendors.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


MASTER SCHEDULE DEVELOPMENT AND MAINTENANCE

 - Maintain traceability to lower level schedules in a variety of tools, exercising judgment on how to summarize lower level plans while still accurately tracking and reporting task progress

 - Participate in regular all-hands meetings and technology progress briefings to stay current with Matter's rapidly maturing products.


SCHEDULE PERFORMANCE REPORTING PRODUCTS

 - Assist in the creation of, and maintain a comprehensive reporting suite for schedule execution and performance, with reporting on a biweekly and monthly basis to internal stakeholders and leadership

 - Provide team members and team leads custom reports, as requested, to assist in the management and execution of that team’s tasks


OTHER BUSINESS ANALYSIS PRODUCTS

QUALIFICATIONS


REQUIRED

 - Typically 5+ years of relevant experience in developing and maintaining schedules for aerospace, construction management, or other large project scheduling or planning

 - Strong ability to apply best scheduling practices and maintain logically valid and meaningful schedules

 - Advanced user of MS Project, Primavera P6, Open Plan or similar scheduling software, and Microsoft Excel

 - Experience in creating and maintaining execution and performance reporting, reporting not just the data but applying expertise to guide teams teams to understand and interpret the data effectively

 - Ability and enthusiasm to expand knowledge and technical skillset

 - Experience in working on deployed/completed projects, with experience throughout the lifecycle, with particular focus on experience in implementation and assembly, integration and test phases.

 - Comfortable and capable of working with diverse teams with widely varying experience in scheduling and planning their work - ability to meet team members where they are and provide guidance on how to organize and plan their work

 - Comfortable interfacing with all levels of management, team leads, and executives, and providing clear and actionable reporting metrics from detail tactical-level tasks to strategic-level initiatives


PREFERRED

 - Familiarity with systems engineering, program management principles, machine learning and AI tools

 - Experience in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary, startup, research, aerospace, or mission-operations environment.


OTHER PLUSES

 - NASA or Aerospace flight mission / instrument experience

 - Familiarity or experience with Earned Value Management

 - Experience in risk management practices and developing and executing schedule risk assessments (Monte Carlo analysis, Sensitivity analysis, etc).

jobs.description:
ABOUT MATTER INTELLIGENCE

Welcome to Matter, where we are building the future of vision AI: pairing a world-first sensor that sees molecular chemistry, temperature, and 3D shape with a Large World Model that will be the most powerful intelligence engine for the physical world. ABOUT MATTER INTELLIGENCE

Matter Intelligence is developing advanced sensing and intelligence capabilities that help governments, operators, and autonomous systems better understand the physical world. Matter’s capabilities span aircraft- and space-based sensing, satellite systems, raw and processed data, and intelligence products derived from advanced spectral information.

Matter is building its government business around difficult national-security, defense, intelligence, civil-government, and commercial missions where better sensing and faster interpretation can produce meaningful operational advantage.


THE ROLE

Matter Intelligence is seeking a Lead of Asian Business Development to establish and lead the company’s government and strategic business-development activities across the Indo-Pacific.

The Lead will initially focus on Japan and South Korea with future opportunities across Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, and the Philippines. The role will be responsible for translating Matter’s technology into country-specific opportunities, establishing relationships with government and industry decision-makers, developing regional market-entry strategies, building qualified pipelines, and converting priority opportunities into funded programs and long-term customer relationships.

This is not solely a relationship-management or account-representation position. The Lead will own the complete regional business-development and capture lifecycle: market intelligence, account planning, customer discovery, partner development, opportunity qualification, capture strategy, proposal development, procurement navigation, negotiation, and contract conversion.

The successful candidate will combine deep knowledge of Indo-Pacific defense and government markets with the ability to operate effectively inside a technically ambitious, early-stage company. This person must be equally comfortable briefing senior government leaders, working through acquisition and contracting details, building partnerships with established aerospace and defense companies, and helping Matter’s technical teams shape products around real customer missions.

The Lead will work closely with Matter’s executive, engineering, product, legal, finance, and operations teams.


GEOGRAPHIC SCOPE

The Director will develop and execute country strategies across:

 - Japan

 - South Korea

 - Australia

 - New Zealand

 - Singapore

 - Indonesia

 - Malaysia

 - The Philippines

Additional Indo-Pacific markets may be added as Matter’s international business develops.

Japan and South Korea are expected to be initial priority markets because of their defense relationships, technological maturity, geospatial and remote-sensing demand, and ability to support regional expansion.


CORE RESPONSIBILITIES


REGIONAL STRATEGY AND MARKET DEVELOPMENT

 - Develop and execute Matter’s government and strategic business-development strategy for the Indo-Pacific.

 - Create differentiated market-entry plans for each priority country based on mission demand, acquisition structures, available budgets, local industrial requirements, and Matter’s technical readiness.

 - Identify the defense, intelligence, civil-government, scientific, environmental, infrastructure, and commercial missions where Matter’s sensing and intelligence capabilities provide the strongest customer value.

 - Prioritize markets and opportunities based on revenue potential, strategic importance, probability of capture, time to contract, technical fit, and required investment.

 - Maintain a regional operating plan that defines target countries, priority accounts, opportunity pipelines, expected bookings, partner strategies, and resource requirements.

 - Provide Matter’s leadership with clear recommendations regarding where the company should invest, partner, establish a local presence, or defer market entry.


GOVERNMENT AND NATIONAL-SECURITY BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

 - Establish relationships with defense ministries, armed services, intelligence organizations, civil-government agencies, space agencies, research organizations, and other relevant public-sector institutions.

 - Develop trusted relationships with senior mission users, technical stakeholders, acquisition officials, procurement organizations, and executive decision-makers.

 - Lead customer discovery to identify operational problems that can be addressed through Matter’s aircraft-based sensors, space-based sensors, satellite systems, data products, and intelligence capabilities.

 - Educate customers on Matter’s technology while gathering specific mission, performance, security, integration, contracting, and deployment requirements.

 - Develop opportunities for demonstrations, evaluations, pilot programs, research agreements, data purchases, sensor sales, satellite partnerships, and operational programs.

 - Build demand before formal procurements are released and help shape requirements around problems Matter is uniquely positioned to solve.

 - Navigate country-specific acquisition processes, budget cycles, tender procedures, contracting mechanisms, security requirements, and industrial-participation expectations.

 - Represent Matter at senior-level government meetings, industry events, trade missions, exercises, demonstrations, conferences, and partner engagements.


CAPTURE AND OPPORTUNITY MANAGEMENT

 - Own the full lifecycle of qualified Indo-Pacific opportunities from initial identification through contract award.

 - Develop capture plans that identify the customer mission, decision-makers, acquisition path, funding source, competitive environment, evaluation criteria, partner strategy, technical solution, pricing considerations, and actions required to win.

 - Establish clear qualification standards and avoid committing company resources to poorly defined or low-probability opportunities.

 - Maintain accurate account, contact, activity, pipeline, probability, value, timing, and next-action information in Matter’s CRM.

 - Build and manage a forecast covering near-term pipeline development, proposal activity, anticipated awards, bookings, and long-term revenue.

 - Coordinate internal bid and no-bid decisions with the Head of Government Growth and Matter’s executive and technical leadership.

 - Lead or support responses to requests for information, requests for proposals, tenders, grant programs, research solicitations, and other acquisition opportunities.

 - Coordinate proposal development across technical, legal, financial, operational, and executive stakeholders.

 - Support commercial structuring, pricing, negotiation, and contract closure.

 - Develop strategies for converting initial demonstrations or pilot programs into recurring data purchases, larger deployments, satellite programs, or multi-year contracts.


PARTNERSHIPS AND REGIONAL ECOSYSTEM DEVELOPMENT

 - Identify and develop relationships with regional aerospace and defense primes, satellite operators, system integrators, analytics companies, research organizations, universities, distributors, and specialized local partners.

 - Determine where Matter should sell directly, work through a local representative, establish a reseller relationship, join a consortium, subcontract to a prime, or pursue an opportunity as the prime contractor.

 - Build joint go-to-market and account plans with strategic partners.

 - Evaluate prospective partners based on customer access, technical contribution, contracting position, reputation, incentives, and ability to improve Matter’s probability of winning.

 - Develop sovereign or locally integrated solutions where required by customer policy or market conditions.

 - Support negotiations involving teaming agreements, memoranda of understanding, reseller arrangements, data partnerships, joint demonstrations, and other strategic agreements.

 - Ensure that partner relationships generate measurable access, opportunities, customer insight, or revenue rather than becoming passive affiliations.


PRODUCT AND TECHNICAL ALIGNMENT

 - Translate customer missions and operational requirements into clear inputs for Matter’s engineering and product teams.

 - Work with technical leaders to define demonstrations, pilot programs, minimum viable capabilities, product configurations, integration approaches, and development priorities.

 - Ensure that proposed solutions are technically credible, operationally relevant, commercially viable, and deliverable within agreed timelines.

 - Develop a strong working understanding of spectral imaging, Earth observation, remote sensing, geospatial intelligence, satellite systems, aircraft-based collection, data products, and analytics.

 - Help create country- and mission-specific sales materials, concept-of-operations documents, technical briefs, demonstration plans, and customer presentations.

 - Communicate product limitations and development dependencies honestly while creating credible paths from current capabilities to future operational programs.

 - Provide structured feedback on regional customer requirements, competitors, pricing expectations, procurement barriers, and product demand.


INTERNATIONAL OPERATIONS AND COMPLIANCE

 - Work with legal and executive leadership to evaluate export-control, sanctions, data-security, technology-transfer, intellectual-property, licensing, and foreign-partner considerations.

 - Incorporate applicable U.S. and local-country regulations into account and capture strategies.

 - Identify localization, sovereign-control, data-residency, security, offset, local-content, or industrial-participation requirements that could affect an opportunity.

 - Help determine when Matter may require local entities, employees, representatives, distributors, facilities, or other forms of in-country presence.

 - Conduct appropriate diligence on consultants, representatives, partners, and intermediaries.

 - Maintain high standards of ethics, transparency, recordkeeping, and compliance in all government and commercial engagements.


INTERNAL LEADERSHIP

 - Serve as Matter’s internal authority on Indo-Pacific government markets, customers, acquisition systems, competitors, and partnership ecosystems.

 - Build repeatable regional business-development processes that can scale as Matter grows.

 - Coordinate international activity with Matter’s U.S. government-growth strategy so that customer engagement, product development, and partnerships reinforce one another.

 - Help determine the timing and structure of future regional hiring.

 - Recruit and manage regional personnel, consultants, advisors, representatives, or channel partners as the business justifies expansion.

 - Contribute to broader company strategy regarding international markets, product priorities, capital allocation, and organizational growth.

 - Present a scalable plan for Matter’s longer-term regional presence, staffing, partnerships, and revenue growth.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Approximately 8–12 or more years of experience in international business development, government sales, capture management, strategic partnerships, or a closely related field.

 - At least five years of relevant experience working with defense, intelligence, space, civil-government, or national-security customers in the Indo-Pacific.

 - Demonstrated experience developing and closing complex government, defense, aerospace, technology, data, or enterprise opportunities.

 - Track record of managing long-cycle, multi-stakeholder sales and capture processes.

 - Strong understanding of government acquisition, procurement, budgeting, contracting, and tender processes in one or more priority Indo-Pacific countries.

 - Established network among relevant government, defense, intelligence, aerospace, space, geospatial, or technology stakeholders in the region.

 - Experience building country strategies, account plans, capture plans, partner strategies, and qualified pipelines.

 - Ability to engage credibly with senior government officials, military officers, intelligence professionals, acquisition personnel, engineers, and industry executives.

 - Ability to understand technically complex products and translate them into mission, operational, and economic value.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

 - Ability and willingness to travel extensively throughout the region and periodically to the United States.

 - High standards of integrity and demonstrated ability to operate appropriately in sensitive government and international environments.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience in Earth observation, remote sensing, spectral imaging, geospatial intelligence, satellite systems, defense technology, aerospace, artificial intelligence, or data and analytics.

 - Experience selling to or partnering with defense and intelligence organizations in Japan, South Korea, Australia, or Singapore.
